bluejetty:00089568:ios.description:
Pass your NP board exam the first time! The newly upgraded SMNP app will simplify your life and accelerate your learning. The app will allow you to more quickly and easily use the full capabilities of the SMNP Primary Care Qbank, as well as our new NP specialty Qbanks, perfectly fitting into your busy schedule and on-the-go lifestyle.
This app is specifically designed for learners with access to the SMNP Reviews Primary Care Question Bank and/or Live Study Group as well as those learners with access to our specialty Qbanks. Use this app to:
• NEW! See your tailored study plan
• NEW! Watch video modules and review with quizzes
• Quickly create practice sets
• Practice with realistic full-length exams
• Seamlessly move between desktop and mobile and see your progress
• Effortlessly study on the go - no matter your schedule!
• Download practice sets for offline practice and sync when you’re back online
What's included:
• NEW! Study Plan: access your personalized study plan and keep up to date with daily tasks to reduce stress and guide your prep effectively.
• NEW! Video Modules and Quizzes: access video modules and tailored quizzes on key board exam topics.
• Extensive Question Library: access hundreds to thousands of practice questions matched to the topics, formats, and pace of the ANCC, AANP, AACN, AANPCB, PNCB, and NCC Certification exams for FNP/AGPCNP, AGACNP, ENP, PMHNP, CPNP, WHNP and 3P learners.
• Detailed Explanations: Maximize your understanding of core concepts with expert explanations for every correct and incorrect answer.
• Customizable Practice Sets: create personalized practice sets that align with your specific needs to target weak areas and concentrate your studying efforts.
• Flexible Practice Modes: choose between Tutor Mode, where you receive immediate answers and explanations as you progress, or Exam Mode, which replicates the exam day experience.
• Comprehensive Topic Breakdown: questions are organized by category, allowing you to focus your practice and review specific areas.
• Offline Mode: easily download practice sets or exams for offline practice and sync when you’re back online.

Q2 News gives you up-to-the-minute local news, breaking news alerts, 24/7 live streaming video, accurate weather forecasts, severe weather updates, and in-depth investigations from the local news station you know and trust.
Connect to your community through our local news app. We're celebrating what makes our community great, giving you context to understand local issues and sharing solutions to help you solve problems.

• View interactive weather radar to help you track rain, snow and storms.
• Get weather conditions and forecasts for your location.
We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00122844:ios.description:
HRAgo allows you to view your account balance, as well specific account activity and history on your Funded HRA, HSA, FSA, and RHSP accounts. 
You can also submit claims, submit benefits card supporting documentation*, update your contact information, make investment allocation changes**, and update your account preferences directly from your iPhone or iPad.
Prior to using HRAgo, you’ll need to have an existing portal user account. If you haven’t already registered your HRA/HSA/FSA/RHSP account under your plan’s respective website, please do this first. Once registered, you can use the same portal account credentials to access your account via HRAgo.
Key Features:
• View current account balance and activity for all of your accounts
• View participant account statements** 
• Submit new HRA, FSA, and RHSP claims
• View and search HRA, FSA, and RHSP claims history
• Submit benefits card supporting documentation*
• View and search benefits card transactions*
• Manage your investment allocations**
• Update your contact information
• Sign up to receive reimbursements via direct deposit
• Use Face ID or Touch ID to log in
* Benefits card features are only available to participants who are enrolled in a plan that offers this option, and have elected to receive a card.
** Feature specific to invested accounts.

bluejetty:00149397:ios.description:
Our School Hangout, an award-winning solution for class management.
Designed for childcare organizations or private education programs that offer classes, camps and before- and after-school care, Our School Hangout streamlines operations, saving time and money. The app offers an enhanced experience for parents and teachers, giving them quick and easy access to the features they need. From class registration and making online payments to staying up-to-date with the latest news and happenings, Our School Hangout makes it easy to organize, share and connect.
Experience this complete and intuitive platform with personalized one-on-one training for your office staff and teachers. Responsive support is only a phone call, email, or a text message away to ensure your needs are taken care of promptly. 
Features:
1. Payment Collection & Accounting
Custom Class Payments
Payment plans specific to each class to fit your needs.
Automated Reminders & AutoPay
Automated payment reminders and AutoPay make late payments a thing of the past. 
Online Payments
Integrated eCheck and Credit Card payments with low processing fees.
Automated Discounts
Turn on automated sibling discounts or apply a discount to individual accounts.
Credit and Refunds
Add a credit to an account for a family or refund back to the original form of payment.
Payment History
Parents can view and download their own payment statements.
One-Time Fees
Add a one-time fee to a family account. 
Detailed Reports
Reconcile bank statements easily.
2. Day-to-Day Management
Dynamic School Calendar
A school-wide calendar with built-in signup tools.
Centralized Parent Resources
Upload essential documents into a single location.
Real-time Rosters
View and download rosters for each class, special program or event.
Attendance Tracking
View and easily update student attendance records. 
Immunization and Health Records
Parents can upload immunization and required health records. 
Classroom Management
Move a student to a different class, adjust sign up days and enroll mid year.
Class Size and Waitlist Management
Set maximum class sizes with an automated waitlist. 
Accept Donations
Receive donations from your parents, church or community patrons.
3. Connected Community & Engagement
Classroom Happenings
Share class highlights in real time with photos and videos.
Directory
Connect your staff, parents and children.
Newsletter
Share exciting news and upcoming events.
Direct Messaging
Communicate to individual parents, a class or the entire school.
Customizable Polls
Gather parent feedback.
Our School Hangout is your complete class management solution to manage your day-to-day administrative tasks so office staff and teachers can focus on the students and growing.

If you are looking for an excellent GPS tracker that can work with Open Street Maps or Google, love outdoor activities or travel - this app is for you!
Record GPS tracks of your trips, analyze statistics, and share them with your friends!
You will love Geo Tracker if you need:
EFFICIENT BATTERY USAGE - We've developed unique background tracking technology that allows you to record accurate GPS tracks for hours while minimizing battery drain. The phone's average charge is enough for a whole day of recording. There's also an economy mode, which you can turn on in the app settings.
DIFFERENT MAPS OF YOUR CHOICE - Mapbox Maps, powered with OSM data, Satellite images, Google maps
OFFLINE TRACKING - If the Internet connection is unavailable, only a GPS signal is needed. You can view tracks and the surrounding area using Google or Mapbox maps, so you always have the most detailed map of the area anywhere in the world. The sections of the map you view are saved on your phone and remain available offline for some time (this works best for OSM/Mapbox satellite imagery). You only need the Internet to download map images.
INCREDIBLE DATA SECURITY - Your privacy is a paramount to us. With Geo Tracker, all your location data stays safe only on your phone, giving you complete control.
ADVANCED TRACKING STATISTICS - Track your progress effortlessly by monitoring various parameters such as track length, speed, and elevation changes, etc., and share detailed screenshots with friends.
SHARING DATA - You can share tracks in GPX, KML or KMZ formats and generate screenshots with the track and statistics. All data is stored only on your device, and only you control the transfer.
ROUTE GUIDANCE & NAVIGATION MODE - You can easily convert any track into a convenient navigation route. Press the button, and the app will generate all the necessary maneuvers. While driving, you can turn on the navigation mode, in which the map automatically rotates in the direction of travel, greatly simplifying navigation.
Geo Tracker will help you:
• Making the way back in an unfamiliar area without getting lost;
• Sharing your route with friends;
• Using someone else's route from a GPX file;
• Marking important or gripping points on your way;
• Locating a point on the map if you know its coordinates;
• Showing off colorful screenshots of your accomplishments on social networks.
Geo Tracker calculates the following statistics:
• Distance traveled and recording time
• Maximum and average speed on the highway
• Time and average speed on the road
• Minimum and maximum altitude on the track, altitude difference
• Vertical distance, elevation, and speed
• Minimum, maximum, and average gradient
• Detailed speed and elevation graphs are available.
Recorded tracks can be saved as GPX files for use in other well-known applications, such as Google Earth or Ozi Explorer. Tracks are stored locally on your device and are not transferred to any servers.

Join millions already using the new Bumble BFF to connect, chat, and build friendships that last.

bluejetty:00120904:ios.description:
Welcome to Bear Haven Motel!
Take on a new part-time job as an electrician and prepare for a unique challenge.
The motel is currently... er, lacking guests, but that’s no reason to worry. 
We’re more concerned about the mysterious electrical issues that occur at night. 
Your job is to fix them, but beware, everything must be in perfect working order by 6:00 AM, or you’re fired! 
Oh, and one more thing. Our "guests" prefer their privacy. Just try to stay out of their way.
Bear Haven is an immersive indie horror game that offers a thrilling survival experience.
Unlike traditional horror games, you’re not limited to watching cameras; instead, you can explore the environment, interact with objects, and solve problems in real time.
Survive terrifying nights in an atmospheric nightmare adventure as you fix the motel’s electrical systems and evade angry bears.
When danger strikes, hide quickly, turn off the lights, silence the phone, and ensure the TV stays off to increase your chances of survival. Do you have what it takes to make it through the first scary night?
Enhance your experience with in-app purchases to remove ads, unlock all game nights, or get exclusive live wallpaper packs. Live Wallpapers are compatible with iPhone 6s & 6s Plus, iPhone 7 & 7 Plus, iPhone 8 & 8 Plus, and iPhone X. On other iPhone models, they can be used as regular wallpapers.
Play now and face the horror of Bear Haven Motel!

Step into a world where you become a legendary carnivores dinosaur hunter, equipped with powerful weapons and survival skills. This dinosaur wali game is designed to test your hunting prowess as you track and hunt the most fearsome creatures to ever roam the earth.
Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action of dinosaur hunting with our dino new game, where each mission is a test of skill and precision. This dino killing game offers a variety of gameplay modes, from stealthy tracking missions to high-octane dino shooting games. Whether you're a casual gamer or a seasoned hunter, the dino ka game has something for everyone.
In our dinosaur wala game, you'll explore vast, detailed environments teeming with life. From dense jungles to arid deserts, each landscape in this dino game presents unique challenges and opportunities. Use your keen senses and advanced equipment to become the ultimate carnivores dinosaur hunter. The dinosaur hunting game mechanics are finely tuned to provide a realistic and satisfying hunting experience.
Prepare for intense encounters in the dino killing game, where quick reflexes and sharp shooting skills are your best allies. Our dino new game features a wide array of dinosaurs, each with its own behaviors and habitats. Whether you’re hunting a swift Velociraptor or a massive T-Rex, every hunt in theDino Hunting:Wild Shooting 3D is a thrilling adventure.
The dino ka game isn’t just about hunting; it’s about survival. Each dinosaur in the dinosaur wali game has realistic AI, making them challenging opponents. As you progress, you’ll unlock new weapons and gear, enhancing your capabilities and allowing you to tackle even the toughest prey in this dino game.
Our dinosaur wala game offers an immersive experience with high-quality graphics and sound effects that bring the Jurassic era to life. The dinosaur hunting game is perfect for players who love the thrill of the hunt and the challenge of tracking down elusive prey. Each mission in the dino new game is unique, with dynamic weather and time-of-day effects that influence your hunting strategy.
Join the ranks of the elite in our Dino Hunting:Wild Shooting 3D, where precision and strategy are key. The dino ka game provides various mission types, from hunting specific dinosaur species to surviving ambushes and protecting yourself from aggressive predators. As a carnivores dinosaur hunter, you’ll need to adapt to changing conditions and use all your skills to succeed.
Experience the ultimate hunting adventure with our Dino Hunting:Wild Shooting 3D. Whether you’re a fan of stealthy approaches or high-action combat, the dinosaur hunting game caters to all play styles. The dinosaur wali game is packed with content, ensuring that there’s always something new to discover. Become the best carnivores dinosaur hunter and dominate the prehistoric world in the most exciting dino game ever created.
In conclusion, our dinosaur hunting game offers a comprehensive and immersive hunting experience that is unmatched in its realism and excitement. Whether you’re tracking down dinosaurs in the dino new game, engaging in intense battles in the dino killing game, or exploring the richly detailed environments of the dino ka game, there’s endless fun and adventure waiting for you. Don’t miss out on the chance to become a legendary carnivores dinosaur hunter in the most thrilling dino game available.

bluejetty:00138845:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Tuscaloosa area with the WFFN 95.3 THE BEAR app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, contests, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from WFFN 95.3 THE BEAR Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Participate in contests and giveaways, plus get exclusive access to station scavenger hunts
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, contests, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the WFFN 95.3 THE BEAR app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the WFFN 95.3 THE BEAR app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

Chillio is your personal planning app that grows with you. Follow a routine that fits your life, level up your habits — and watch Chi's world transform as you do.
Start with the routine that fits you best, and let Chi cheer you on every step of the way.
The Cutest Life Planning And Cleaning App
Create Your Own Tasks:
Set up habits that match your lifestyle - daily, weekly, or fully custom.
Track your habits with simple check-ins or use units like minutes, steps, or repetitions.
Stay in control with a clean, distraction-free interface focused on your goals.
Track Your Progress:
Visual progress bars show how consistent you are with each habit.
Build streaks and strengthen your momentum day by day.
View detailed stats to stay motivated and see how far you’ve come.
Gamify Your Routine:
Earn XP every time you complete a task.
Level up as you stick to your habits and unlock new milestones.
Collect coins for every completed habit - rewarding you for consistency.
Monitor your total XP, coins earned, and level in your personal dashboard.
Subscription Information:
Chi offers auto-renewing subscriptions for unlimited access to Premium features:
• $19.99/month
• $39.99 every 3 months
• $89.99/year
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, based on the selected plan.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase. Canceling your subscription will stop future charges, but you’ll retain access until the end of the current billing period.

Privacy Policy: https://pp.my-chi.app/

bluejetty:00186983:ios.name: iTIVA Anesthesia Plus
bluejetty:00186983:ios.summary:
Introducing iTIVA: Your Ultimate Pharmacokinetic / Pharmacodynamic Simulation App
Are you a medical professional looking to enhance precision and efficiency in drug administration while expanding your knowledge in pharmacokinetics? Look no
bluejetty:00186983:ios.description:
Introducing iTIVA: Your Ultimate Pharmacokinetic / Pharmacodynamic Simulation App
Are you a medical professional looking to enhance precision and efficiency in drug administration while expanding your knowledge in pharmacokinetics? Look no further than iTIVA, the leading pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic simulation application designed to revolutionize the way you estimate drug concentrations in plasma and optimize infusion schemes!
Key Features:
• Accurate Drug Concentration Estimation:
Harness the power of cutting-edge mathematical models to estimate drug concentrations in plasma. iTIVA offers an extensive library of 28 drugs and 70 pharmacokinetic models, empowering you to control anesthesia IV drugs like an expert.
• Target Controlled Infusion (TCI) Simulation:
Take control of TCI pumps like never before! iTIVA simulates TCI pump behavior, allowing you to calculate infusion schemes to attain and maintain desired target concentrations in plasma or effect site. It's like having a reliable assistant right at your fingertips.
• Comprehensive Drug Library:
From Remifentanil, Propofol to Heparin and beyond, iTIVA boasts an impressive range of 28 drugs to cater to your unique needs.
(Remifentanil, Fentanyl, Sufentanil, Alfentanil, Hydromorphone, Morphine, Ketamine, Procaine, Lidocaine, Propofol, Etomidate, Dexmedetomidine, Midazolam, Remimazolam, Thiopental, Atracurium, Cisatracurium, Rocuronium, Vecuronium, Sugammadex, Tranexamic, Magnesium sulfate, Diazepam, Heparin and Protamine)
• Explore Drug Interactions:
With 70 pharmacokinetic models and 10 pharmacodynamic models at your disposal, iTIVA facilitates in-depth exploration of drug interactions.
• MAC Age Calculation:
Quickly determine end-tidal (Et) concentration for Isoflurane, Sevoflurane, and Desflurane using the Mapleson equation. No more guesswork – iTIVA streamlines the process for you.
• Intraoperative Milestones & Case Sharing:
Record crucial intraoperative milestones and effortlessly share cases with colleagues using QR codes. Collaboration has never been this seamless!
• Save and Run Multiple Simulations:
Save your simulation cases for future review or run multiple simulations simultaneously. iTIVA adapts to your workflow and maximizes efficiency.
• Excel Data Export:
All recorded information can be conveniently exported as an Excel file. Stay organized and analyze your data with ease.
iTIVA's yearly subscription is available for US$9,99/year. 
• The subscription will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
More details can be found here 
iTIVA Privacy Policy: https://itiva.co/privacy.html
Terms and Conditions: http://itiva.co/terms.html

bluejetty:00164052:ios.description:
Skill: Ski Tracker & Snowboard
Skiing and snowboarding lovers, this is the app for you! Whether you enjoy casual skiing & snowboarding and want to track your progress, or are a professional seeking a ski or snowboard tracker, this is the app that will help you take your skills to the next level.
With a trusted GPS tracker, Skill: Ski Tracker & Snowboard will detect when you ride and how fast you’re going, when you are on a lift or take a rest, and record your ski tracks automatically — Even without an internet connection. Record all your movements and track your progress and even compete with other users!
Just run the app and put your phone in your pocket!
With Skill: Ski Tracker & Snowboard you can:
* Record detailed statistics - even without internet connection
* Compete with friends and other riders
* Record and save your ski tracks
* Keep track of your speed
* Explore new areas with our ski map
* Discover ski resorts near you
* Find official resort pistes
SHOW YOUR SKILL TO YOUR FRIENDS
Improve your ski skills and compete against your friends. With Skill, you can always know exactly where your friends are.
All you need to do is simply add your friends to Skill: Ski Tracker & Snowboard and track their location on the ski map in real-time with GPS tracking. Need to meet up with your friend? Our professional ski tracker will help you find out exactly where they are for easy communication on the mountain -don’t lose them in the snow! Once you’ve located your friends, you can message them directly on the app’s chat with no need to switch between apps to talk to one another! Now riding in a company and improving your skills has never been easier or more convenient.
COMPETE WITH OTHER RIDERS IN REAL TIME!
Record your stats on the slopes with our GPS tracker and check out where you rank among your friends and other competitors world wide or per resort.
Find out you where you rank in either snowboarding or skiing (or both), in the following:
Max Speed
Total Distance
Best time compared to other riders on a specific resort's piste
Go back to check the top ranks year-round to see how your ski and snowboarding skills compare to other riders throughout the season and challenge yourself!
Track your speed with our ski and snowboarding tracker at each slope and view your rank world-wide in real time! No more wondering if you’re the best. Now you’ll be able to know you are!
SKILL RESORT MAP
Skill will help you view resorts across the world that offer snowboarding and skiing slopes, for an optimal experience on the mountain. Enjoy your winter activities with the Skill snowboard and ski when visiting a resort. Explore new winter resorts available, observe new trips and maps on Skill.
Whether you’re a ski professional or a snowboard beginner, whether you prefer extreme skiing, steep slope or backcountry skiing, Skills is the perfect app for you, download now and start enjoying and tracking your progress!

listings.description:
A tracker for skiers and snowboarders that automatically records every run.

Speed, distance, your route on the resort map, and friends on the mountain in real time. Just put your phone in your pocket and ride.

NO BUTTONS TO PRESS

Skill knows the difference between a run, a lift ride, and a break. Every run is saved automatically, even when there’s no signal on the mountain. No need to take off your gloves.

YOUR WHOLE DAY ON THE MAP
- Speed and distance for every run, day, trip, and season
- Your tracks on the resort trail map
- Personal records you’ll want to beat
- Your whole season in one place
Open any run to see where you reached top speed, which trails you took, and how that day compares with your best.

YOUR FRIENDS ARE ON THE MAP TOO

After a lift ride, someone always gets separated. With Skill, you can see your friends on the map in real time and message them right in the app. No need to call with frozen fingers or text, “Where are you?” Find each other and get back to riding.

WHO’S FASTER?

Think you’re the fastest in your group? Find out.
- Top speed
- Total distance
- Best time on a specific trail
Compete with friends, at your resort, or with riders around the world. Skiers and snowboarders have separate leaderboards.

OVER 5,000 SKI RESORTS
- Colorado: Vail, Breckenridge, Aspen Snowmass
- Utah: Park City, Snowbird, Deer Valley
- California: Mammoth Mountain, Palisades Tahoe, Heavenly
- Wyoming: Jackson Hole, Grand Targhee
- Montana: Big Sky, Whitefish Mountain
- Vermont: Stowe, Killington, Sugarbush
- New Hampshire: Bretton Woods, Loon Mountain
- The Alps: Courchevel, Zermatt, Ischgl, the Dolomites
Open a resort map, check out the trails, and plan your next trip.

FOR EVERYONE WHO RIDES
- Beginners: see how far you made it on your first day
- Speed lovers: set new records on freshly groomed trails
- Park and freestyle riders: keep a record of every run
- Freeriders: see your route and distance on the map
- Families and groups: keep everyone on one map

AND IN SUMMER, TOO
Skill tracks downhill rides in bike parks and hikes in the mountains.

Download Skill and just ride. It’ll record every run for you.

Continuous GPS use in the background may reduce battery life.

bluejetty:00145481:ios.description:
Block ads across all apps — and browse with a real VPN. One app.
Naka strips ads, trackers, and malware system-wide — in Safari and across your apps — then hides your IP and encrypts your connection with a fast WireGuard VPN. Effortless privacy that just works, without sending your data anywhere.
WHAT NAKA BLOCKS
• Ads — in Safari and across your apps
• Hidden advertising trackers that profile you in the background
• Malware and dangerous sites
• Adult content (optional Parental Control)
GO PRIVATE WITH NAKA VPN
Without a VPN, your real IP address and location are exposed to every site, app, and network you touch — and your provider can see where you go. Turn on Naka VPN to:
• Hide your IP address and encrypt your connection
• Stay private on public Wi-Fi
• Connect through fast global servers
FASTER, LIGHTER BROWSING
• Pages load faster with ads stripped out
• Less mobile data used
• Less battery drained
YOUR PRIVACY, NOT A PRODUCT
Other ad blockers route your browsing through their servers and log it. Naka blocks on your device — we don't log or sell your browsing activity. Your data stays on your phone.
FREE & PREMIUM
• Free: ad & tracker blocking, malware protection
• Premium (Naka VPN): full WireGuard VPN, global servers, unlimited use

bluejetty:00066134:ios.description:
Mighty Party combines action, strategy, and dynamic battle mechanics to deliver an engaging card game experience. Challenge mobile gamers worldwide, dominate the battle arenas, and rise to the top! We'll redefine battle team collection games!
Craft your offensive and defensive strategies with thousands of card combinations. Powerful heroes are a start, but cunning tactics and strategies will win the day. Use your wits, develop cunning tactics and strategies, or unleash brute force to slay your enemies!
Join guilds and clans to crush opponents and bosses for valuable loot and claim the battle crown!
Download the game for free and experience epic turn-based battles in an exciting world!
Game Features:
● Innovative turn-based and fast-paced battle system. Real strategy and tactics required!
● Infinite battle combinations from dozens of war heroes.
● Epic Warlords with unique skills.

Note:
Mighty Party is free to download and play, but some game items can be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please set up password protection for purchases in your App store settings.
A network connection is required.

Visit our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/mightyparty.game
Join our Discord Server: discord.gg/mightyparty

bluejetty:00132281:ios.summary:
Become the main character of your own romance. Play by your own rules.
Welcome to Dorian - the romantasy games hub where your choices shape your destiny. Fall for dangerous love interests, survive horror stories, uncover paranormal secrets
bluejetty:00132281:ios.description:
Become the main character of your own romance. Play by your own rules.
Welcome to Dorian - the romantasy games hub where your choices shape your destiny. Fall for dangerous love interests, survive horror stories, uncover paranormal secrets, and create your own unforgettable romance.
Whether you're into dark romance, slow burns, enemies-to-lovers, or chaotic bad boys, Dorian lets you experience stories your way.
「Discover Your Next Obsession」
Explore a growing collection of interactive stories and visual novels from independent creators. Fall for dangerous love interests, make impossible choices, and unlock unforgettable endings across romance, horror, fantasy, and paranormal adventures.
Featured Stories
- Slashfic by Jess Delfanti, ValerieOS & Kellie Storm - romance slashers to survive.
- Shark Bait by Rose Magpie - dangerous shark gods, unforgettable romance, and impossible choices.
- Hellbent & Bloodbound by Magic Shop Games - choose between angels, demons, and vampires in high stakes worlds of supernatural temptation
- The Curse: A Moonlight Romance by Inspector Lemon & AKrCos - a magical vampire romance where love and destiny collide.
「Your choices matter」
Every episode is yours to shape.
- Make meaningful choices that change the story.
- Romance your favorite characters.
- Unlock premium scenes, outfits, and special endings.
- Replay episodes to discover new routes.
- Level up relationships to unlock free rewards with your favorites!
Whether you're looking for an otome game, dating sim, interactive fiction, or visual novel, Dorian gives you stories you'll want to replay again and again.
「Join the community」
Connect with your favorite creators in a community of fans just like you!
- Chat with fellow fans.
- Follow your favorite creators.
- Get exclusive events, rewards, and updates.
- Discover new romance stories every week.
「Have a story to tell?」
Dorian gives creators the tools to build interactive fiction, grow a passionate fanbase, and publish visual novels with no coding required. Turn your story into a playable experience in hours instead of months or years, creating branching romances, unforgettable characters, and immersive interactive adventures for players around the world.
Let’s get social!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dorian.live/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dorian.live
Discord: https://discord.gg/vCbqzjHvFs
Terms of Use: https://dorian.live/#terms-of-use

bluejetty:00129519:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Lafayette area with the HOT 107.9 app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, contests, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from HOT 107.9 Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Participate in contests and giveaways, plus get exclusive access to station scavenger hunts
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, contests, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the HOT 107.9 app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the HOT 107.9 app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00089609:ios.name: Denver Savings Bank
bluejetty:00089609:ios.summary: The Denver Savings Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so
bluejetty:00089609:ios.description:
The Denver Savings Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
DSB Card Manager: Control your DSB debit card and spending. Turn your debit card off and on with the push of a button. Schedule recurring payments and let the bank know if you are traveling on vacation for travel exclusions. Keep tabs on your budget by viewing transactions by merchant or spending categories.
SAFE AND SECURE

bluejetty:00028678:ios.description:
Welcome to Day N Night—where the boundary between life and the supernatural blurs. Test your survival skills and zombie-slaying abilities in this thrilling action-adventure game. Are you ready for the challenge?
Key Features:
- Dynamic Day-Night Cycle:Navigate a world where daylight offers brief safety for gathering and crafting, but nightfall unleashes terrifying supernatural zombie creatures.

- Crafting and Combat: Master crafting to build powerful weapons, from mystical swords to arcane crossbows, enhancing your ability to fend off the night’s dangers.
- Epic Zombies and Boss Fights: Encounter unique zombies each night and take on epic bosses that push your survival and combat skills to their limits.

bluejetty:00179387:ios.description:
Can't sleep and love the sound of rain? Welcome to Rainy, the new high-end rain audio app by the creator of Thunderspace, Windy, Sunny, Away and Flowing.
You'll love Rainy because I did not hastily create it over the weekend. Rainy is a lavishly crafted big budget production that took over a year of work for you to enjoy tonight, free of charge.
Rainy features a great variety of amazingly polished rain audio scenes. Each scene comes with a 3D motion-controlled parallax illustration with real rain recorded in psychoacoustic 3D for headphones. 
Feel free to mix in additional nature sounds like birds and crickets, or music. Customize your ambiance, set the timer and sleep or relax to some of the highest quality rain recordings on the planet. I guarantee for that with my name, Franz Bruckhoff.
I've teamed up with some of the best people in the world to make Rainy the best it can be. Enjoy fantastically relaxing music composed for Rainy in Hollywood.
You deserve to enjoy the highest attainable quality. Nothing has been left to chance here. Rainy is an abnormally high-value production, into which many incredibly talented people have put all their heart and attention to detail. And today you can download Rainy for FREE. Give it a try, see and hear for yourself what Rainy is all about.
The FREE portion of Rainy comes with two beautiful, top-quality rain scenes for you to enjoy. No annoying ads, no tricks. And with some luck, you may even receive another fantastic scene for free. It's absolutely amazing.
Want more? Subscribe to Rainy Plus, a high-quality rain audio subscription service at a low price. Get access to a growing collection of excellent 3D rain audio scenes with incredibly high production value, and help me produce more for you by becoming a happy subscriber.
Rainy includes so many things:
• A great variety of rainy nature ambience scenes
• Unlimited playback time, infinitely looped (very long loops)
• Taptanium™ neural 3D audio™ (incredibly immersive)
• Taptanium™ certified quality nature audio
• Mixer: Mix and match some extra nature sounds and music
• Music composed for Rainy in Hollywood
• Adjustable fade-out and sleep timer
• Full background audio support
• Universal app for iPhone and iPad
• Beautiful audiovisual experience
• Optimized for iPhone X, XR, XS & XS Max, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max & iPad Pro!
≈ Subscription terms and pricing ≈
Rainy Plus is optional and gives you unlimited access to Rainy’s growing catalog of incredibly high-value rain audio scenes and content. You may choose between two auto-renewing subscription options:
$2.99 every three months ($1 per month)
$9.99 per year ($0.83 per month)
Not into subscriptions? You're free to buy Rainy Plus for a supportive one-time payment instead. Thank you!
Prices mentioned above are for customers in the United States. Prices and charges may vary based on your applicable currency. Please refer to the Top In-App Purchases section for detailed pricing information.
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You may turn off auto-renew by going to your iTunes & App Store account settings, though there are no refunds for unused portions of your subscription term. If you choose to subscribe, your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Terms of Service: http://taptanium.com/tos
Privacy Policy: http://taptanium.com/privacy
≈ Questions? ≈ 
Tweet @taptanium, email franz taptanium com or send an email through the in-app contact support page.

bluejetty:00071287:ios.description:
** Best New App ** – Apple
** Best Motivation App ** – Healthline
** Top Apps of the Day ** – Product Hunt
“The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step” – Lao Tzu
Motivate is your first step towards a more driven, focused and inspired life. Experience empowering full-length speeches from some of the world's most inspiring speakers exclusively in-app. Watch five new motivational videos each day or browse our library of thousands of videos including categories and curated playlists. Listen on the go with background play and build your daily habits with positive reminders from customizable notifications. View, favorite and share thousands of inspiring quotes directly in the app or see them on your Home screen with the Quotes Widget. Enjoy exclusive music to get you inspired, energized, relaxed or focused. Whether you're waking up, at work, in the gym or just need that extra boost to get you through the day, Motivate has you covered.
CUSTOMIZED CATEGORIES
Essentials - Everything you need to seize the day, focus your mind and get rid of bad habits like procrastination, fear, and doubt with an added dose of motivation.

bluejetty:00170532:ios.name: Ad Blocker Pro: Safari & DNS
bluejetty:00170532:ios.summary:
Ad Blocker Pro - a cleaner, faster, more private browsing experience.
Ad Blocker Pro applies the same 240,000 blocking rules in Safari and in the app's built-in browser. Either way ads are practically gone - on almost every site, not a sin
bluejetty:00170532:ios.description:
Ad Blocker Pro - a cleaner, faster, more private browsing experience.
Ad Blocker Pro applies the same 240,000 blocking rules in Safari and in the app's built-in browser. Either way ads are practically gone - on almost every site, not a single ad gets through. On-device DNS protection adds to that, blocking known tracker domains and encrypting your DNS traffic.
Ad blocking in Safari
Just turn on the Safari extension and ads practically vanish from the Safari you already use. 240,000 rules go to work, and on almost every site not a single ad is shown.
- 190,000 blocking rules: banners, video ads and pop-ups are stopped before they load. The request never happens, so pages open faster and use less data.
- 26,000 element-hiding rules: the frames and gaps the ads used to sit in are removed, so the page closes up neatly.
- 16,000 advanced rules: they handle ads injected by scripts and ad-block detection, with dedicated rules for 35,000 sites.
- 22,000 exception rules: the traffic a site genuinely needs is let through, so pages keep working.
Built-in ad-blocking browser
The app also includes its own browser, applying the same rules at the same strength as Safari. There is no extension to set up - ads are practically gone from the moment you install.
- Multiple tabs and tab pinning: switch freely between tabs and pin the pages you use most.
- Intuitive gesture controls: swipe to switch tabs, go back or forward, or close a tab.
- Private tabs: browse without leaving any history.
- Desktop site: switch a stripped-down mobile page to its desktop version.
- Find in page: locate a word in a long article in seconds.
- Downloads and bookmarks: save files and keep the pages you return to.
- Voice search: search by speaking, without the keyboard.
- History: retrace the pages you want to look at again.
- Open just the browser: press and hold the app icon and choose Browser to jump straight into the built-in browser. You can also make a dedicated icon with the Shortcuts app.
- Autofill integration: your IDs and passwords work with iOS Password AutoFill.
DNS protection
On-device DNS protection uses a blocklist of 160,000 entries to stop known tracker domains before they load, and encrypts your DNS lookups with DNS-over-HTTPS, so which sites you visit stays hidden from third parties. Everything happens on your device - your traffic is never routed through our servers, and your personal information is never collected or sent externally.
Filter updates
The filters and rules are updated every few days. You can check the version and the rule count in use at any time under Filter information in the app.
Statistics
- Today's blocked count: see how many trackers were blocked, in real time, on the statistics screen.
- Daily and monthly statistics: look back with easy-to-read graphs.
Highlights
- Faster browsing: with ads practically gone, web pages load faster.
- Stronger privacy: blocking tracker domains and encrypting your DNS traffic keeps you more private online.
- Reduced data usage: prevent unnecessary data from loading and save on data.
- Dark mode: automatically matches your device's theme.
- Multilingual: available in 35 languages.
- One-time purchase: pay once and keep it. No monthly fee, no renewals.
Privacy protection
We put your safety and privacy first, so you can use the app with peace of mind. It never collects or transmits any of your personal information.
Recommended for
- Anyone who wants fewer ads in Safari
- Anyone who wants fast, private browsing
- Anyone who wants a browser with built-in ad blocking
- Anyone who values online security and privacy
- Anyone who wants to save on mobile data
- Anyone who frequently visits ad-heavy sites
- Anyone looking for a simple, easy-to-use privacy app

bluejetty:00083016:ios.name: Steller: Travel Planner App
bluejetty:00083016:ios.summary:
Steller is a travel planning app that makes finding the best things to do easy and planning your next trip stress fee. 
PLAN YOUR NEXT TRIP
Our trip builder combines AI and the power of the human experience to help you create the perfect
bluejetty:00083016:ios.description:
Steller is a travel planning app that makes finding the best things to do easy and planning your next trip stress fee. 
PLAN YOUR NEXT TRIP
Our trip builder combines AI and the power of the human experience to help you create the perfect trip. Hidden gems, the hottest spots on Instagram, the must sees – you can find, explore, and book them all in the Steller app. 
ASK BIRDIE
Birdie is your new trip planning assistant! Birdie knows all the best spots, local tips, and must-see attractions. She learns your preferences and tailors recommendations just for you. Need dining tips, outfit advice, the best time to visit, or safety tips? Birdie's got you covered! From spontaneous getaways to detailed itineraries, Birdie makes trip planning a breeze. Click + New Trip and tap the Birdie icon to start chatting!
SEARCH ANY DESTINATION ON EARTH
Search and find travel videos and recommendations for any destination. Whether you’re looking for travel recommendations you can trust in San Diego or Kathmandu — you’ll find them on Steller. 
BE INSPIRED BY A GLOBAL COMMUNITY OF TRAVELERS
Want to explore a new destination, but don’t know anyone who has been there? Each destination on Steller has videos from real travelers allowing you to see it from different perspectives.
BOOK UNIQUE EXPERIENCES & FAVORITES 
Whether you’re looking for a unique experience or the most popular attractions you can book it in minutes on Steller.
FIND YOUR TRAVEL FAM
Connect with people like you who love to travel and explore the way you do. 
THE MAP YOU’VE BEEN WAITING FOR
Zoom in on the Steller map to find something to do nearby. Map locations are infused with videos from real travelers giving you a sneak peek before you go. 
SWIPE UP FOR DETAILS
Wondering where a travel video is located? Swipe up to find the location, Google directions, and details about a place right inside Steller.
SAVE YOUR FAVORITES
Have a trip coming up? Save all your favorite recommendations, videos, places to stay, and things to eat to a trip. 
SHARE YOUR OWN VIDEOS
Took a trip and want to share about it? Ate at a restaurant that slaps? Had an experience you can’t keep to yourself? Upload a quick video and show the community.
BOOK A STAY
Places to stay at every price point. You may even discover some unique stays you won’t see anywhere else.
TRAVEL WITH CONFIDENCE
Reviews you can trust combined with videos from other travelers and the creators you love, means you’ll know what to expect before you go. Steller gives you all the information you need to feel confident in your travel choices.
USE THE MAP
If you’re looking for somewhere to eat or something to do right where you’re at — use the map on Steller to find something close by.
Terms of service — https://steller.co/terms
Privacy Policy — https://steller.co/privacy
Have feedback? Contact us at https://steller.co/contact

bluejetty:00015553:ios.summary: Dinosaurs lived on Earth millions of years ago, long before our ancestors emerged on the face of the planet. These amazing animals boggle our imagination by their variety and size. Some were small like modern lizards, others as huge as a mu
bluejetty:00015553:ios.description:
Dinosaurs lived on Earth millions of years ago, long before our ancestors emerged on the face of the planet. These amazing animals boggle our imagination by their variety and size. Some were small like modern lizards, others as huge as a multi-storey building. Some were predators, for example the Tyrannosaurus Rex, Allosaurus, Velociraptor, Spinosaurus, while others were herbivorous - like the Diplodocus, Ankylosaurus and Iguanodon. Some species could fly, some lived in water, but most of them walked on the ancient land. Dinosaurs lived in the Mesozoic era, which is subdivided into three periods: Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous. Today, archaeologists study the remains of these animals and can only assume how they looked and lived. 
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

Signature Bouquets: Find the bouquet of flowers of your dreams. Rare & seasonal blooms, including orchids, lilies and many Indian flowers.

Luxury Hampers: Send happy birthday flowers that make an impact. Our luxury hampers are the answer, combined with other gifts as well. Cake jars, chocolates, scented candles, indoor plants, and an array of other luxury items.
Personalised Options: Aesthetic packaging that resonates with your loved one. Add a handwritten note. There, you made your luxury flower bouquet more meaningful.
Corporate and Bulk Gifting: A fulfilling bulk gifting purchase for corporate events, wedding decor, and recurring gifting programmes. 
Trusted by names like Dior, Saint Laurent, Manish Malhotra, Sabyasachi we understand the language of luxury and brand expression.
Explore Occasion Specific Collection
Now order flowers online for all your special celebrations. On Interflora app, you can use our robust filter feature to view arrangements based on the occasion. 
Birthday Flowers: 
Mark the annual milestone with our birthday flower bouquet collection featuring radiant sunflowers, lilies, and gerberas. 
Anniversary Flowers: 
You can order an anniversary flower bouquet or a box arrangement designed specifically for the occasion.
Festivals: 
Buy themed-based bouquets, centerpiece decor, and much more right through our app!
The Delivery Perks and Network. 
Our online flower delivery process is streamlined. Discover a flexible delivery schedule that meets your preferences.
- Same-day Delivery: The same day flower delivery is available at 40+ Indian cities.
- Fixed-day Delivery: Book your flowers online at a fixed time and date. 
- Nationwide Reach: With 100 floral studios and 180+ in-house designers, we cover all regional tastes and deliver nationwide. From a flower delivery Delhi or to a remote location in UP.
- Real-Time Tracking & Confirmation: Dispatch to handover, get live updates and delivery confirmation. Send flowers online with ease.
Serving across 25+ major cities, our flower delivery online includes Mumbai, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Pune, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Indore, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Ahmedabad, and others.
Send a flower birthday bouquet and gift hamper abroad. Our international network spans across countries like USA, Canada, UAE, Germany, New Zealand, Australia, and more.

Cold Chain and Freshness Assurance: Through our cold-chain flower supply, we guarantee 5 days of freshness for your blooms.
Exclusive Offers: In-app launches and the best offers available for a limited time. Receive promo codes and first-time customer deals.
White-Glove Delivery: Experience courteous handoffs by our logistics team along with unboxing.
Vocal for Local: We source from the best local growers in India or abroad, we use only quality blooms and provide them in sustainable packaging. 
Personal Touch: For every unique need of our customers to handcrafting each piece with care, we strive to create a “WOW” reaction.
Download now and make every 'floral' moment matter.

bluejetty:00013668:ios.description:
They grow in large numbers in forests and fields. Millions of them are hiding in the protective thicket and many withstand an eager collector. The common mushroom, dearly loved treasure in many kitchens. But once it's found, fundamental doubts replace the initial euphoria. What kind of mushroom is this actually? Is it edible, perhaps toxic, even hallucinogenic? 
Finally, you have the option to identify species without the help of a heavy book. You get a comprehensive library full of facts, figures, and images. Learn where to find mushrooms, look up if they are edible. Find inspiration and experience nature in a whole new way.
SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED
A subscription, purchased in the app, is required to use this app. All content and features in this description are only available with an active subscription. Price, length, and auto-renewal are shown in the app before you subscribe.
CONTENT
* 300 species - 2000 images
* Extensive description of the species
* Species names in 11 languages
* Scientific identification
* Online Mushroom Consultation
* Quiz game
SEARCH AND IDENTIFY SPECIES BY
* APPEARANCE AND SCENT
- size, color, hat, gills, stem, etc.
* EDIBILITY AND TASTE
- toxic, edible, allergen, etc.
* FRUIT BODY TYPE
- belly mushrooms, gilled mushrooms, truffle, etc.
* HABITAT
- deciduous or coniferous forest floor, etc.
* FAMILY
- Agaricaceae, Boletaceae, Clathraceae, etc.
* MEDICINAL BENEFIT AND POISON
- antibiotic, Psilocybin, Muscarin, etc.
QUIZ GAME
* Guess species from pictures
* Learn to distinguish different species
ONLINE MUSHROOM CONSULTATION
Amateur mycologists and app users from around the world will help you identify mushrooms. Submit photos of your finds and you’ll soon receive initial suggestions.
ABOUT NATURE MOBILE
The mission of NATURE MOBILE is to present exciting topics from nature and other areas to a wide audience of interested people, enthusiasts, and experts in an attractive way.
Privacy Policy: https://www.naturemobile.org/pages/privacy-policy-apps/
Terms of Use: https://www.naturemobile.org/pages/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00060827:ios.description:

1. Manage Money Coming In

2. Manage Money Going Out
Record expenses and bills and categorize them right from your iPhone. Get to know how much you owe and always pay your bills on time.
3. Your Accountant is never far away

4. Business Insights In Your Pocket
Do you have enough cash for payroll and paying supplier bills? How much do your customers owe? What are your top expenses? Answers to these are just a tap away.

Get to track time you spend on your projects and bill them right from the app. 
6. Going Global. No worries!
Zoho Books supports transactions in multiple currencies and is precision personified.
7. No limitations!
There is absolutely no limitations on the number of transactions or users who can access Zoho Books. Truly unlimited! 
8. Get Paid Instantly, Anywhere
Turn your phone into a POS with the all new Tap to Pay feature for Stripe users using Zoho Books. Collect payments on the spot and have them seamlessly synced with your books without the need for any manual entry.

ABC15 Arizona in Phoenix gives you up-to-the-minute local news, breaking news alerts, 24/7 live streaming video, accurate weather forecasts, severe weather updates, and in-depth investigations from the local news station you know and trust.

Connect to your community through our local news app. We're celebrating what makes our community great, giving you context to understand local issues and sharing solutions to help you solve problems.

LOCAL NEWS:
• Get up-to-the-minute breaking news alerts and stories.
• Tap 'Top News' to read the most important news of the day as curated by our local news teams.
• Tap 'Most Recent' to read the news stories published most recently.
• Get full support for Dark Mode and Light Mode based on your device preference.

LOCAL VIDEO:
• Watch our 24/7 live streaming news channel.
• Watch video on demand clips from recent newscasts.
• You're in control over what you want to watch and when.

LOCAL WEATHER:
• Get daily video weather updates from your trusted local weather team.
• Stay up to date with hourly and daily weather forecasts.
• View interactive weather radar to help you track rain, snow and storms.
• Get weather conditions and forecasts for your location.

We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.

Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00138444:ios.description:
Prepare for your motorcycle license with the Motorcycle DMV Written Test app, the ultimate tool for acing your DMV motorcycle tests across the United States. This comprehensive app offers a vast array of resources, including practice tests for every state, from the California motorcycle DMV written test to the Ohio motorcycle permit test. Whether you're a beginner aiming for your first license or an experienced rider looking to refresh your knowledge, our app provides detailed practice questions for every aspect of motorcycle riding and safety. Get access to tests like the Illinois DMV motorcycle license test, NC motorcycle permit test, and the WA motorcycle DMV test to ensure you're fully prepared for the specifics of your state's DMV.
**Benefits:**
- **Ensure Success:** Join countless others who have successfully passed their motorcycle license tests on the first try.
- **Efficient Preparation:** Maximize your study efficiency with targeted practice tests, reducing your prep time while enhancing comprehension.
- **Confidence on Test Day:** Enter your test day with the assurance that comes from thorough preparation and practice.
**Features:**
- **User-Friendly Interface:** Simple navigation and clear layout make it easy for all riders to use.
- **State-Specific Practice Tests:** From the TX motorcycle license test to the GA motorcycle written test, tailor your practice to your state's requirements.
- **Updated Question Banks:** Includes the latest motorcycle test questions and answers, reflecting current DMV standards.
- **Comprehensive Coverage:** Extensive material on all topics, including motorcycle laws, safety procedures, and road handling.
- **Free Practice Tests:** Unlimited access to practice tests, with no fees or subscriptions required.
- **No Registration Needed:** Start preparing immediately without the need to sign up.
- **Multilingual Support:** Available tests in multiple languages to accommodate a diverse range of users.
Download the Motorcycle DMV Written Test app today and take the first step toward obtaining your motorcycle license with confidence. Whether you're preparing for the PA motorcycle permit test or need to pass the motorcycle knowledge test in SC, this app is your comprehensive guide to mastering the DMV motorcycle test.

Try the MathEdge system FREE in this version! 
Practice addition with our step-by-step guide at no cost, or purchase the full version for both addition AND subtraction.
To learn addition and subtraction with a step-by-step guide, there's no other app like MathEdge!
Loved by teachers and students around the world - MathEdge makes it easy to learn early math skills. No more struggle!
Features: 
- Addition step-by-step guide 
- Addition flash cards: easy, medium, and hard
- Audio instructions 
- Caters to both left and right handed children 
- Great for classrooms or at home
- Subtraction step-by-step guide (purchase to unlock)
- Subtraction flash cards: east, medium, and hard (purchase to unlock)
Every student is on their own unique learning challenge. MathEdge is customized to your child's needs. Questions are adapted for your student's strengths and weaknesses.

• Choose between a right-handed or left-handed layout for ease of use. 
• See how to properly arrive at each answer with a guided step-by-step experience that teaches valuable math skills such as "carrying the one" and "borrowing."
"It teaches how to add the single digits of numbers, carry the one if needed, and then add the left column to arrive at the final answer. It's a simple way to teach math step by step." - Kate Archer, parent 
"This is a really great app. I love the fact that it talks the student through the problems. This is especially helpful in helping a student to stay on task. The voice is very kind and encouraging." - Marian Williams, ADD Mom and Special Educator
Want your child to learn more?
With MathEdge you can turn screen time into learning time. Premium members improve their scores faster, spend more time practicing with math questions, and get exclusive access to subscriber-only areas.
Don’t want a subscription just yet? We will always offer educational content at zero cost. Try the app for yourself!
Peekaboo Studios is a family-friendly developer seeking to promote quality apps for kids and families.
Recommended Ages: 8-10
Categories: Math, Addition
We love to hear from you!
Please send any feedback or questions to hello@peekaboo.mobi

bluejetty:00148703:ios.name: Hemocytometer Sidekick
bluejetty:00148703:ios.summary:
Make cell counting with a hemocytometer effortless!
You know the drill--time to count cells for your experiment. Get out the hemocytometer and squeaky mechanical counter, prepare your dilution, fill the chamber, then look under the scope a
bluejetty:00148703:ios.description:
Make cell counting with a hemocytometer effortless!
You know the drill--time to count cells for your experiment. Get out the hemocytometer and squeaky mechanical counter, prepare your dilution, fill the chamber, then look under the scope and start pushing the lever. Get to the end of a square, write down the count, reset the counter, and repeat. Finally, try to remember the right calculation, then write down the result.
What if you didn't need the squeaky counter? The scrap paper? A manual calculator?
Sure, you *could* get an expensive, fancy cell counter with wasteful disposables. But why do that when a $5 app is nearly as good?
Hemocytometer Sidekick eliminates those annoyances. Record one or two counters for all samples with automatic calculations (including viability, blood counter), and use the full grid or the center square. Data is saved for you, so you can record it in your notebook at your convenience.
Hemocytometer Sidekick, designed from the ground up by a biologist, will make your life in the lab so much easier, that I'm giving you 10 measurements for free!
Features:
- Optimized for eyes-free operation (large buttons, sounds, vibration)
- Use both chambers and zoom in to inner grid
- Chamber types: Basic, Improved Neubauer, Bürker-Türk/Thoma, Fuchs-Rosenthal, Jessen, Spiers-Levy, Malassez, Makler
- One or two counters available, plus viability and blood (RBC, WBC, Platelet) counter
- Differential blood counter for many white blood cell types
- Pause and sound every 100 blood cells counted
- Automatic calculations
- Adjustable chamber depth
- Email results
- Prompt support

Can’t find the right groom? You're headed for an arranged marriage with a rich old man!
But suddenly, four irresistible suitors appear in your life...
Could one of them be your way out?
"What if we just pretend to be in love?"
You’ve entered high society to escape your political marriage, but things get a lot more heated than expected!
"If someone sees us like this, it could ruin you."
Set in the glamorous 19th-century English social scene, where romance and passion are never far away, you must navigate thrilling encounters as a strong, bold young woman. 
Can you find your 'perfect proposal' before time runs out?
[ Game Introduction ]
Storytaco presents Gentleman’s Proposal: Spicy Romance Fantasy Otome, a steamy, mature love story that lets you shape your romantic destiny. 
With every choice, a new twist awaits. Will you capture the heart of your dream suitor and write your happily ever after?
(Warning:) Your choices will shape the outcome of your story—choose wisely!
[ Game Story ]
"A dazzling debutante stirs up high society!"
With four intriguing men vying for your attention, the stakes have never been higher.
Your arranged marriage to a wealthy older man looms, and only finding the right suitor can free you from this fate!
Thanks to a royal contract, you’ve made a dazzling debut.
But when the season ends, will you have received the perfect proposal?
Theodore – The icy knight who suggests a contract relationship
"Sometimes, a little danger is worth it."
Ashton – The distant perfectionist who melts just for you
"You’ve become someone special to me."
Ryan – The mysterious knight from another land, brimming with allure
"Maybe fate has brought us together."
Derek – The devoted childhood friend always by your side
"Don’t worry, I’ll be here no matter what."
Dive into thrilling, passionate affairs and compete for the affection of these captivating men.
Can you escape your arranged marriage and secure your happily-ever-after? 
Find out in Gentleman’s Proposal, the ultimate spicy romance fantasy otome game!

① Steamy romance stories for players who want more excitement!
② Unlock stunning outfits and accessories to elevate your romantic journey.
③ Raise affection levels and collect stunning, high-quality romantic illustrations that bring your love story to life!

- Fans of romance games with deep world-building and European royal backdrops.
- Anyone who enjoyed Kiss in Hell, Moonlight Crush, or Kiss of the Knight.

• Activate your cards 
• View real-time balance and transaction history 
• Manage your scheduled transfers and view history

• Set and change your card PIN 
• Send a secure message to the Member Services team

• Deposit multiple checks at once with Mobile Deposit

bluejetty:00050129:android.description:
Do you remember posters of your favorite movies? Will you guess what the film is in front of you by the actors on the poster? Will you remember the name of the cartoon character on the image?
This quiz is a real catch for any cinephile! 750 movies, cartoons and TV series, 50 interesting levels, classic movies and current movies of different genres and countries of production — all are in one application.
Do you want to be known as a real film expert? Complete this game 100%: earn coins, go to the app every day for taking bonuses, spend them on hints, unlock new levels and guess all the movies.
In addition to the main levels, the application contains thematic packages with questions. Among them: Horror movies, French movies, Comedies, Detective Movies, Action movies, Cartoons, Fantasy movies, War movies, Sci-Fi Movies, Soviet movies, TV Shows, Superhero movies, Movies of 2019-2020, Biography Movies, Sports Movies, Christmas movies, Movies of the '60s.
Are you tired of the main game mode or have you passed it completely? Then play additional mini-games and compete with other gamers:
▸ Arcade. In this game you need to open the poster by parts. As quickly as possible guess what the film is hidden behind the squares. The fewer pieces you will unlock, the more points you will get.
▸ Guess the Movie. The game shows a poster and several answers. You have to choose the right one.
▸ True or False. On the screen you can see the name of the movie. You need to answer whether the poster matches this film or not.
🎥 Movie quiz features 🎥
★ 750 films, series and cartoons of various genres, countries and years of release.
★ 50 interesting levels.
★ Main mode + 3 mini-games. In the application you will always have something to do.
★ If you want to know more about the guessed movie or if you found some movie whose poster you are interested, and you want to watch it, the application has a button which will open you IMDB with information about the movie, where you can learn more about it.
★ Earn coins by guessing movies and levels and visiting the app every day. Via coins you can buy hints that will help in difficult situations.
★ Do you want to compete with a friend or other players? Earn the most number of points in mini-games and get the first place!
★ Game statistics. You will always know how many percent of the game you have passed, and how many movies you have to guess.
★ The app is available in 10 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese.
★ Intuitive, simple and beautiful interface.
★ The application works on smartphones and tablets.
This product uses the TMDb API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDb.

bluejetty:00145971:ios.description:
Navigating the world of diabetes? Whether you have diabetes or dealing with prediabetes, MyDiabetes is tailored to guide your journey with precision. From tracking your HbA1c and glucose levels to delivering meal guidance that suits your tastes, we've got you covered.
Easily manage and keep tabs on your weight, glucose levels, and overall health progress. Crafted for those grappling with high blood sugar, weight challenges, and other diabetes-associated concerns, MyDiabetes provides top-notch guidance.
Start your MyDiabetes journey by monitoring your health with tracking tools for blood sugar, HbA1c, water intake, medication, and more.
With the Premium upgrade, you’ll get access to exclusive MyDiabetes features, such as a fully personalized diabetic meal plan, a simplified grocery list for your weekly shopping, no-equipment needed home workouts, and much more. 
We believe that every person deserves to live the best life possible. Therefore, we ensured that with the Premium feature of a personalized meal plan, you would enjoy a diabetes-friendly diet without being forced to eat the foods you don’t like.
MyDiabetes Health Tracking Features:
- All-Inclusive Health Tracker:
Effortlessly monitor glucose levels, HbA1c, medication, and carbs. Vital for medical consultations and to ensure your regimen aligns with your health state. Integrated with the Apple Health app for a seamless experience.
- Activity Overview:
Always stay up-to-date with your recent app activities. Log daily meals, workouts, hydration, and overall health progress, and simply maintain your daily diabetes log.
MyDiabetes Features with a Premium upgrade:
- Personalized Diabetic Meal Guidance:
Tailor-made meal plans that fit your caloric, carb, sugar, and cholesterol requirements. Plus, a plethora of healthy diabetic recipes and a handy carb tracker.
- Efficient Shopping Lists:
Quickly gather ingredients via our organized weekly grocery lists.
- Home-Based Workouts:
Engage in effective workouts curated to your liking, no equipment required. Elevate your health via our diabetic weight loss guidance from home.
- All-Inclusive Health Tracker:

bluejetty:00130723:ios.name: Camo Studio – Stream & Record
bluejetty:00130723:ios.summary: Dive into streaming, or record your next video, in just a few taps – hone your scene, connect your camera, and start creating with ease – all directly from your iPhone or iPad. Camo Studio is free, and a finalist in Apple’s 2025 App Store A
bluejetty:00130723:ios.description:
Dive into streaming, or record your next video, in just a few taps – hone your scene, connect your camera, and start creating with ease – all directly from your iPhone or iPad. Camo Studio is free, and a finalist in Apple’s 2025 App Store Awards.
STREAM & RECORD FROM ANYWHERE
Connect a mic to your iPhone, or cameras and mics to your iPad, and start streaming on the move, and record your video to built-in or connected storage for editing and uploading high-quality content later.
SHARE YOUR GAMING MOMENTS
On iPad, stream console games with a capture card to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and more. On iPhone, stream your mobile games with a spare phone as your facecam. Set up your scene with tactile controls that make multi-feed and PiP simple to configure.
SWITCH UP YOUR SCENES
Quickly switch between a collection of built-in or custom scenes with a tap to help engage your audience or show a different shot. Each scene can be configured individually with different cameras, video and audio sources, and output profiles, and layered with text, images, shapes, video and web pages.
PRO STREAMS WITH WEB OVERLAYS
Imbue your streams with your personal aesthetic, or a professional touch, with support for web overlays from StreamElements, Streamlabs, Uno Overlays and more. Import template or custom web overlays, with live content, alerts, embedded control panels, and a wide array of other widgets.
A ONE-APP STREAM CONTROL CENTRE
Stay in touch with your chat, trigger in-stream events, and check on your mods, all through Camo Studio’s stream panels. Add exactly the panels you need – each is custom to the streaming service you use, and gives you powerful controls for your livestreams.
POWERFUL VIDEO ENHANCEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS
Camo Studio comes loaded with functionality that helps you stand out. Easily apply a subtle “Bokeh” effect to your background, or replace it or remove it entirely! Adjust the framing and orientation of each input feed, including Auto-framing modes that help you stay in-shot.
MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR IPHONE
Your iPhone becomes a complete live studio: use your front and rear cameras at once, flick the controls away for a clean view, and when your phone warms up, Camo Studio eases the frame rate instead of dropping your stream.
MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR IPAD
Your iPad supports connecting a breadth of peripherals, external devices and cameras, with every panel in view on the bigger screen. Use it as a bigger, sharper screen for your Nintendo Switch, or as a video monitor for your camera. M1 and later iPads can even run Camo Studio in the background while streaming or recording, capturing the device’s screen, and can integrate with your Stream Deck.
SECURITY AND PRIVACY FIRST
Camo Studio transmits your video directly to the streaming services of your choosing, and all recordings are entirely local to your iPhone or iPad, connected storage device or selected storage service. Your data is your business, not ours.
NOT ONLY BUT ALSO!
- Pro-quality video in a range of resolutions, including 4K UHD, 1080p HD, and 720p
- Built-in galleries come preloaded with backgrounds and filters to try in your videos
- Work in landscape, portrait or square orientations, great for TikTok-style shots at 9:16 aspect ratio
- Use your device’s front and back cameras as part of your scene
- Add any spare phone or tablet running Camo Camera as another angle over Wi-Fi
- Plug in a USB mic, or connect a Bluetooth mic like AirPods, and sound as good as you look
- Looks great in light and dark mode
- No ads in the app, ever
WE’RE HERE TO HELP
We’re fanatical about supporting our users, and we’d love to help you make the most of Camo Studio on your iPhone or iPad. Reach out to us any time: https://camo.com/support
LEARN MORE
About us:
https://camo.com/studio/iphone
https://camo.com/studio/ipad
How to use Camo:
https://camo.com/support/camo-ipad/how-to-use-camo-ipad
FAQ: https://camo.com/support/camo-ipad/camo-ipad-faq
