On iPad, stream console games with a capture card to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and more. On iPhone, stream your mobile games with a spare phone as your facecam. Set up your scene with tactile controls that make multi-feed and PiP simple to configure.

SWITCH UP YOUR SCENES
Quickly switch between a collection of built-in or custom scenes with a tap to help engage your audience or show a different shot. Each scene can be configured individually with different cameras, video and audio sources, and output profiles, and layered with text, images, shapes, video and web pages.

PRO STREAMS WITH WEB OVERLAYS
Imbue your streams with your personal aesthetic, or a professional touch, with support for web overlays from StreamElements, Streamlabs, Uno Overlays and more. Import template or custom web overlays, with live content, alerts, embedded control panels, and a wide array of other widgets.

A ONE-APP STREAM CONTROL CENTRE
Stay in touch with your chat, trigger in-stream events, and check on your mods, all through Camo Studio’s stream panels. Add exactly the panels you need – each is custom to the streaming service you use, and gives you powerful controls for your livestreams.

POWERFUL VIDEO ENHANCEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS
Camo Studio comes loaded with functionality that helps you stand out. Easily apply a subtle “Bokeh” effect to your background, or replace it or remove it entirely! Adjust the framing and orientation of each input feed, including Auto-framing modes that help you stay in-shot.

MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR IPHONE
Your iPhone becomes a complete live studio: use your front and rear cameras at once, flick the controls away for a clean view, and when your phone warms up, Camo Studio eases the frame rate instead of dropping your stream.

MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR IPAD
Your iPad supports connecting a breadth of peripherals, external devices and cameras, with every panel in view on the bigger screen. Use it as a bigger, sharper screen for your Nintendo Switch, or as a video monitor for your camera. M1 and later iPads can even run Camo Studio in the background while streaming or recording, capturing the device’s screen, and can integrate with your Stream Deck.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY FIRST
Camo Studio transmits your video directly to the streaming services of your choosing, and all recordings are entirely local to your iPhone or iPad, connected storage device or selected storage service. Your data is your business, not ours.

NOT ONLY BUT ALSO!
- Pro-quality video in a range of resolutions, including 4K UHD, 1080p HD, and 720p
- Built-in galleries come preloaded with backgrounds and filters to try in your videos
- Work in landscape, portrait or square orientations, great for TikTok-style shots at 9:16 aspect ratio
- Use your device’s front and back cameras as part of your scene
- Add any spare phone or tablet running Camo Camera as another angle over Wi-Fi
- Plug in a USB mic, or connect a Bluetooth mic like AirPods, and sound as good as you look
- Looks great in light and dark mode
- No ads in the app, ever

WE’RE HERE TO HELP
We’re fanatical about supporting our users, and we’d love to help you make the most of Camo Studio on your iPhone or iPad. Reach out to us any time: https://camo.com/support

bluejetty:00062517:ios.summary: Supercharge your note-reading speed and accuracy by playing just 10 minutes a day. Since 2019, NoteQuest has helped tens of thousands of teachers & piano students build lifelong skills without the gimmicks or fluff. Unlock real music fluenc
bluejetty:00062517:ios.description:
Supercharge your note-reading speed and accuracy by playing just 10 minutes a day. Since 2019, NoteQuest has helped tens of thousands of teachers & piano students build lifelong skills without the gimmicks or fluff. Unlock real music fluency – Get NoteQuest, your drill practice & sight-reading companion.
LIKE 2 APPS IN 1! 
Use GAME DRILLS (one-time purchase) to master note recognition and intervals on your instrument
And/Or get SIGHT READING (subscription) to practice with real musical excerpts by level, from Beginner to Advanced.
REAL OR VIRTUAL PIANO
Whether you're sitting at a real piano, practicing in class with MIDI headphones, or away from your keyboard using our Virtual Piano, NoteQuest is your ultimate sight-reading companion. 
FEATURES IN DETAIL:
· GAME DRILLS (one-time purchase): Focuses on timed note recognition, 2-note reading (intervals). We begin with Landmark Notes, then Single Notes, and Intervals, the key to sight reading fluency. Simply tap the timer to turn it off for no-pressure practice!
· Note Selector (included in Game Drills) is the perfect way to CREATE YOUR OWN Game Drills and save them to play anytime! 
· SIGHT READING (subscription): Choose between Piano, Violin, Viola, and Cello, and progress through the levels starting with Level A featuring Landmarks C4, G4, F3. There are more than 230 exercises from Beginner to Advanced. *This section is not gamified with a timer. 
· Stats: See score stats and earn Badges for daily practice (Sight Reading only)
· Piano Mode choice: Real Piano responds to your instrument. Virtual Piano can be played anywhere. MIDI mode lets you connect it to your keyboard. (Bluetooth friendly)
· Themes: Customize your background in Game Drills. 
Learning piano shouldn't mean getting stuck on note-reading. NoteQuest transforms tedious sight-reading practice into engaging, bite-sized daily challenges.
► Try it now for free! (Game Drills Free version includes Landmark Notes & Level 1). 
__________
Note! There are 2 upgrades in Note Quest: 
1. GAME DRILLS (Single upgrade purchase, keep forever)
Play timed note drills to get you the best start to actual music reading. This is the ONLY known app that focuses on 2-note reading (intervals), the real pathway towards sight-reading fluency!
2. SIGHT READING (Subscription): 
Get over 230 curated, leveled exercises, Beginner to Advanced. These sight-reading excerpts have a variety of musical styles, not boring, randomized notes that don't sound musical. Check your accuracy by tapping LISTEN, and it plays back the correct form so you can compare what you played. 
CHORD CRUSH - educational chord-learning exercises to get your chord game on! Learn to read chord symbols while developing skills you can use for a lifetime!
Don't own an iPad? PDF Sight Reading Flashcards are available! Visit our website to check them out.
Questions or issues to report? Suggestions? Email: info@notequest.net or DM me on Instagram. @notequestapp
Grace, Founder and Piano Teacher See: www.notequest.net

We support people living with persistent back pain, neck pain, whiplash, fibromyalgia and br
bluejetty:00079901:ios.description:
MoreGoodDays® is a clinically designed digital health program supporting recovery from chronic musculoskeletal pain and stress-related conditions.
We support people living with persistent back pain, neck pain, whiplash, fibromyalgia and broader musculoskeletal conditions - as well as those recovering from a recent injury or stressful experience.
Built by clinicians and people with lived experience, MoreGoodDays combines structured programs, practical tools, and optional coaching from qualified psychologists and physiotherapists.
What’s inside the app
Structured Recovery Programs
- Chronic Back Pain
- Chronic Whiplash
- Chronic Musculoskeletal Pain
- Fibromyalgia
- Everyday Resilience
Each program is delivered in simple, step-by-step sessions designed to fit into real life.
Optional Clinician Coaching
You can access dedicated coaching from qualified psychologists and physiotherapists to guide you through your program and tailor support to your needs.
If you enroll in a full program, coaching sessions are structured into your plan. You can also book additional sessions if you’d like more personalised support.
Practical Tools for Everyday Recovery
- Short guided sessions (10–15 minutes)
- Sleep and relaxation meditations
- Stress regulation tools
- Movement and mobility videos
- Flare-up support strategies
- On-demand education library
- Live webinars with clinical experts
Everything is designed to be manageable, practical, and grounded in evidence-based approaches.
How access works
The app is free to download, with limited preview content available.
Full access is available through:
- Self-payment, or
- Eligible health insurers and injury schemes (for approved members)
If you’re referred by a partner insurer, your access to our programs including clinician support, is fully funded.
Who this app is for
MoreGoodDays may be helpful if you:
- Live with ongoing back, neck, or musculoskeletal pain
- Experience persistent symptoms after injury
- Want structured support beyond medication alone
- Notice stress impacting your recovery
- Are adjusting after a stressful experience
If you are experiencing severe distress or a mental health crisis, please seek immediate support from your GP or local mental health services.
Designed with care
Our programs are grounded in recognised evidence-based approaches and delivered by experienced clinicians. We work alongside health insurers, employers, and injury schemes to improve access to practical, structured recovery support.
MoreGoodDays is not a replacement for medical treatment. Always follow the advice of your healthcare provider.
Disclaimer: MoreGoodDays® is a self-management and wellbeing tool. It is not intended to replace professional medical treatment or care. Continue to follow your healthcare provider's advice and any treatments or medications they have prescribed. Always seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions. If you have any thoughts of harming yourself or others, please call 911 (or your local emergency number) or go to the nearest emergency room immediately.
Read our terms and conditions: https://www.moregooddays.com/policy/terms
Read our privacy policy: https://www.moregooddays.com/policy/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00015086:ios.description:
It's party time! With 10,000+ cards, Charades game brings fun and excitement to your party with your friends and family. 
[Highlights]
- Over 10,000 cards, and more to come! 
- A.I. generated decks
- Easy tilt screen control
- Suitable for all ages
- Good for 2-10 people
[How to play]
1. Face the screen to your friends
2. They give clues and you guess the words
3. They cannot speak the word (or part of word) on screen
4. Tilt down the screen to mark the word as correct
5. Tilt up the screen to skip the word
[Decks]
- Delicious Food
- Things to Do
- Movie Fans
- Living Things
- World of Music
- Amazing Places
- Popular Brands
- On the Show
- For Gamers
- Must Reads
- Cities & Countries
And more to come! 
[A.I. generated cards]
We use machine learning (ML) to generate our cards from a mixed dataset of dictionary words, wikipedia text corpus and commonly used phrases. We built a binary classifier with logistic regression, to identify fun words based on sentiment analysis, popularity, etc. All generated cards are human reviewed to ensure that they are indeed fun to play. If you would like to learn more about how our binary classifier works, here is a great tutorial: http://cs229.stanford.edu/notes/cs229-notes1.pdf

・新聞の代わりに通勤・通学中に手軽に情報収集したい方

bluejetty:00099108:ios.description:
Remote Control - Onn Smart TV: Your Smartphone,Transformed into the Ultimate Streaming Command Center.
Elevate Your Viewing Experience with Intelligent, Intuitive Control! 
In today's on - demand entertainment landscape, your smartphone should be the most powerful tool in your viewing arsenal. 
Remote Control - Onn Smart TV reimagines what a streaming companion can be - blending cutting - edge functionality with effortless usability to put complete command of your TV ecosystem in the palm of your hand. 
This sophisticated application transcends the limitations of traditional remotes, offering a smarter way to navigate your favorite content. 
Through seamless Wi-Fi connectivity, your mobile device becomes an extension of your entertainment system - instantly recognized and ready to deliver precision control without the hassle of setup or configuration. 
Key Advantages That Redefine Streaming Control:
- Automatically detects and pairs with your devices the moment you launch the app;
- Program one - tap shortcuts to your most-watched channels and streaming services; 
- Experience fluid, responsive control with our optimized touchpad interface;
- Enjoy silent operation perfect for late-night streaming session; 
Unlike cluttered traditional remotes with dozens of rarely - used buttons, Remote Control - Onn Smart TV presents an intelligent control scheme that adapts to how you actually watch content. 
The intuitive layout ensures you'll spend less time figuring out controls and more time enjoying your entertainment. 
In an era where we demand instant access and personalized experiences from our technology, Remote Control - Onn Smart TV delivers where conventional remotes fall short.
 It's the perfect fusion of smart design and practical functionality - equally suited for movie enthusiasts who demand precision control and casual viewers who value simplicity. 
Subscription Details
Your subscription will be charged to your Apple ID at purchase confirmation. It automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. 
Renewal charges occur 24 hours before each period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions anytime via your Apple ID settings in the App Store. 
Cancellations take effect after the current billing cycle. You'll receive advance notice before renewals. 
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00014542:ios.description:
Ready to sell your toys and collectibles?
Ozone Toys buys collectible toys, dolls, video games, and Funko Pops directly from you. No listings, no auctions, and no waiting for a buyer. Just scan, ship, and get paid.
Whether you are selling a few items or a full collection, Ozone Toys provides a faster and simpler way to sell from home.
How It Works
Scan or Search
Scan an item’s barcode with your phone or search by name to get an instant offer.
Import Your Collection
Already track your collection on HobbyDB? Connect your account to import your collection to see our offers more quickly.
Ship Your Items
Use a prepaid shipping label to send your items to us. Submissions over $100 ship for free, and smaller shipments use discounted shipping deducted from your payout.
We Review Condition
Once your shipment arrives, our team inspects each item.
If something does not match the original details, we will send photos and a revised offer before payment is issued.
If you decline a revised offer on your first shipment, you can request a free return.
Get Paid Fast
After the review is complete, payment is typically issued within one business day by PayPal or mailed check.
What You Can Sell
Ozone Toys buys a wide range of toys, collectibles, and games, including items from popular brands and properties such as:
• Funko POP!
• LEGO
• Star Wars
• Barbie
• Monster High
• Transformers
• WWE
• Nintendo
• Pokémon
• Disney
• Marvel
• DC
• Bandai/Banpresto
• Good Smile Company
• Squishmallows
• Hot Wheels, Matchbox, and model kits
Why Sellers Use Ozone Toys
• Instant Offers — See an offer before you ship on eligible items
• Sell From Home — No meetups, listings, or back-and-forth with buyers
• Prepaid Shipping — Simple shipping with free or discounted label options
• Clear Review Process — Photos and revised offers if condition issues are found
• Fast Payments — Payment is typically issued within one business day after review
• First-Shipment Return Protection — Free returns if you decline a revised offer on your first shipment
No listings. No auctions. No haggling. No meeting strangers.
Download Ozone Toys and start selling today.

bluejetty:00068860:ios.description:
Would you like to start smoking cessation by recording your smoking frequency?
This app is an app that can easily record the number of cigarettes smoked.
By tapping the plus button on the home screen each time you smoke, you can record the number of times you smoked and the start time of smoking today.
The "Analysis" screen displays a graph of the number of cigarettes smoked each week, month, and year. In addition, the average number of cigarettes smoked per day and the smoking time interval are displayed.
The History screen shows a record of smoking times for the date selected in the calendar. To delete the smoking record, tap the delete button at the right end of the data.
On the "Settings" screen, you can set the first day of the week of the calendar. You can choose to start on Monday or Sunday.
In the free version, you can check the smoking record for up to one week.
If you want unlimited recordings and want to see your monthly and yearly data, consider purchasing the in-app Pro version.
----------------------
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://akikibai-labolatory.jimdofree.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00174646:ios.name: Meditate: Meditation Timer
bluejetty:00174646:ios.summary:
Build a meditation practice that feels truly yours.
Shape each session with a flexible meditation timer, watch your personal Mandala bloom as you practice, and capture how every meditation feels with free reflections and journaling.
An Ap
bluejetty:00174646:ios.description:
Build a meditation practice that feels truly yours.
Shape each session with a flexible meditation timer, watch your personal Mandala bloom as you practice, and capture how every meditation feels with free reflections and journaling.
An Apple Design Award finalist for Visuals and Graphics, Meditate brings your practice to iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.
MEDITATE YOUR WAY
Keep your timer simple or shape every stage of your meditation. Choose a fixed duration or an open goal, set alerts at chosen moments or repeating intervals, select sounds or haptics, and meditate with ambient music or Apple Music.
Save complete sessions as Timer Presets so they are always ready. On supported devices, simply describe the meditation you want and let Meditate configure it for you. If you continue beyond the completion alert, Meditate keeps tracking your extra time.
WATCH YOUR MANDALA GROW
Your personal Mandala blooms as you meditate. Return each day, maintain your streak, and watch your practice take shape over time.
REFLECT ON EVERY SESSION
Record how you felt before and after meditating, capture your thoughts, and add or edit a reflection for each day. All reflection and journaling features are free, helping you notice how your practice feels—not only how long it lasts.
You can also log meditations completed outside the app so your history, goals, and streaks remain accurate.
UNDERSTAND YOUR PRACTICE
Explore today’s progress, your past seven days, monthly calendars, individual sessions, and long-term statistics.
Meditation Insights helps you discover meaningful patterns across your practice. Ask Meditate lets you ask questions about your meditation history and receive answers grounded in your recorded sessions. You choose whether optional information from reflections and Apple Health can contribute to your insights.
With Meditate Premium, connect Apple Health to bring mindful minutes and supported sessions from other apps into your history. Track heart rate during supported sessions and relate sleep and State of Mind to your practice.
MADE FOR APPLE WATCH
Meditate works independently on Apple Watch. Run advanced sessions, use Timer Presets, monitor heart rate, record reflections and State of Mind, review your progress, and keep your practice within reach with complications and Smart Stack widgets.
ALWAYS WITHIN REACH
Start a meditation or check your progress from widgets, the Lock Screen, Control Center, Shortcuts, Siri, and Live Activities. Use Siri or Spotlight to find past sessions on supported devices, and keep your meditation history, reflections, and progress up to date across your devices with iCloud.
Share sessions, achievements, and statistics as beautiful artwork, with personalized visuals available on supported devices.
MADE FOR APPLE VISION PRO
Meditate is also available on Apple Vision Pro, bringing your meditation practice into a beautifully immersive spatial experience.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Meditate includes essential features such as the meditation timer, session history, daily goals, streaks, seven-day summaries, CSV export, and all reflection and journaling tools.
Premium unlocks Timer Presets, advanced interval alerts, Alert Behavior, ambient music, Apple Music, additional Mandalas, advanced statistics, Meditation Insights, Ask Meditate, and Apple Health integration. Choose a monthly or yearly plan, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Family plans cover up to six people through Family Sharing.
Ask Meditate requires English and a compatible Apple Intelligence device. Natural-language timer setup and other features may vary by device and operating-system version. Apple Music requires an Apple Music subscription. Apple Health features require your permission.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Service:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00177682:ios.name: 22 Days: Habit Tracker
bluejetty:00177682:ios.summary:
22 Days is a habit tracker, daily goal tracker, and routine planner designed to help you build better habits and stay consistent every day.
Create habits, track your progress, follow your schedule, complete daily goals, and turn small acti
bluejetty:00177682:ios.description:
22 Days is a habit tracker, daily goal tracker, and routine planner designed to help you build better habits and stay consistent every day.
Create habits, track your progress, follow your schedule, complete daily goals, and turn small actions into long-term routines. Whether you want to improve your health, fitness, productivity, mindfulness, learning, nutrition, finance, or self-care, 22 Days gives you a simple and flexible way to stay on track.
The idea is simple: focus on your habit every day, track your progress, and keep going. Follow your habit for 21 days, then use one extra day to help make it stick.
HABIT TRACKER FOR DAILY ROUTINES
• Track daily habits, goals, and routines
• Create flexible habit schedules for different days of the week
• Mark habits as done and follow your daily progress
• Track habits with metrics like minutes, hours, pages, steps, calories, distance, money, items, and more
• Split bigger habits into smaller subtasks
• Organize your habits with groups and categories
• Customize habits and groups with your own colors
• Choose whether missed habits should reset automatically or not
• Use multiple profiles for different users, goals, or life areas
• Stay motivated with personal motivation styles
• Complete challenges and keep yourself engaged
• Use widgets to check your habits and progress at a glance
• Get daily reminders for your habits and routines
• Track habits faster with Apple Watch
• Sync your habits across your Apple devices
BUILD ANY HABIT
22 Days can help you create and track almost any habit, routine, or personal goal:
• Morning routine
• Fitness and workouts
• Running or walking
• Reading
• Learning a language
• Drinking water
• Meditation and mindfulness
• Saving money
• Healthy eating
• Productivity habits
• Self-care routines
• Reducing screen time
• Daily tasks and personal goals
PERSONAL MOTIVATION
Everyone builds habits differently. 22 Days helps you stay motivated with different motivation styles, so your habit tracker can feel more friendly, calm, strict, coach-like, or challenging depending on what works best for you.
FLEXIBLE PROGRESS TRACKING
Not every habit is just “done” or “not done.” With metrics, subtasks, schedules, and optional auto-reset, you can track your routines in a way that fits your real life.
Use simple check-ins for daily habits, subtasks for bigger routines, or metrics for measurable goals like reading pages, walking steps, tracking calories, saving money, or spending time on a task.
UPGRADE TO PRO
Upgrade to 22 Days Pro with a one-time purchase and unlock the full habit tracking experience:
• Unlimited habits
• Groups
• Subtasks
• Metrics
• Custom colors
• Multiple profiles
• Extra customization
• App lock protection
• No ads
Start building better habits with 22 Days — your habit tracker, daily goal tracker, and routine planner for long-term progress.

bluejetty:00036571:ios.description:
Chaffey FCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Chaffey FCU:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Chaffey FCU app, you must be enrolled as a Chaffey FCU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00016001:ios.description:
Everyone’s Favorite Movie Ticket App. Over 147K 5-Star Reviews!
Atom is the only mobile movie ticketing app that lets you buy movie tickets, make movie plans with friends & get a VIP experience at the theater so you never wait in line. Find all the latest new and upcoming movies, watch trailers, read reviews, add movies to your watchlist & browse showtimes directly from the app. When you get to the movie theater, skip the box office line & scan your digital movie ticket with your iPhone or Apple Watch.
ATOM LETS YOU…
• BUY MOVIE TICKETS & SKIP THE LINES: Get tickets ahead of time & reserve your seats with a few easy taps — no waiting at the box office.
• PRE-ORDER CONCESSIONS: Add your favorite snacks to your order & pick them up at an express lane (at participating locations).
• WATCH MOVIE TRAILERS: Watch movie trailers right from the movie posters or from the Trailers Tab.
• ADD MOVIES TO YOUR WATCHLIST: Get notified when tickets go on sale.
• PLAN A MOVIE NIGHT: Invite friends, pay separately & send your seat assignment with a few taps. No more group texts.
• LINK THEATER LOYALTY ACCOUNTS: Connect your favorite loyalty accounts to earn points when you buy tickets on Atom. 
• RECEIVE EXCLUSIVE MOVIE OFFERS: Stay in the know on special movie ticket discounts and promotions.
PLUS, ATOM’S BIG ON CONVENIENCE
• Pay how you want: Credit Card, Apple Pay, PayPal, Venmo, and Amazon Pay 
• Go together, pay separately. No more IOUs 
• Buy tickets for all standard & premium formats
• Apple Watch support for viewing your tickets

bluejetty:00183363:ios.description:
Flowwow is a marketplace for flowers and gifts, connecting you with over 20 000 shops across 25+ categories — bouquets, cakes and desserts, gift sets, cosmetics, live plants, balloons, edible bouquets, gift cards, and more.
Whether you're celebrating someone from afar, picking out the perfect gift for a big occasion, sending a sweet surprise, or treating yourself, Flowwow makes it easy. Delivery starts in as little as 30 minutes and is available in more than 1 300 cities across Russia and beyond.
FLOWWOW APPLICATION FEATURES
FIND THE RIGHT GIFT FOR ANY OCCASION
Birthday, anniversary, wedding, baby shower, New Year or simply a chance to make someone smile — find the perfect option from thousands of offers by local shops and brands.
SEND A GIFT TO ANOTHER CITY
Enter the recipient's city and address, and the app will show you what's available nearby. You can arrange delivery to someone you love, no matter how far away they are.
SURPRISE SOMEONE WITHOUT KNOWING THEIR EXACT ADDRESS
Not sure where to send the gift? Select "Confirm with recipient" at checkout, and they'll enter their own address and preferred delivery slot.
TRACK YOUR ORDER FROM CHECKOUT TO DELIVERY
Follow your order status every step of the way, from confirmation to delivery. Before dispatch, the seller sends a photo of the bouquet, cake, or gift for your approval.
CHOOSE SELLERS YOU CAN TRUST
With over 8 million ratings and reviews from real orders, it's easy to compare shops, see other customers’ experiences, and choose the option that's right for you.
MESSAGE SELLERS DIRECTLY
Use in-app chat to ask sellers about order or item details.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE FLOWWOW
• Over 20 000 shops, all in one app.
• 25+ categories: flowers, florist’s special bouquets, edible bouquets, cakes and desserts, gift sets, make-up & perfume, live plants, balloons, home decor, gift cards, and more.
• Genuine ratings and reviews from real customers.
• A photo of your order before delivery — see the gift before it's given.
• Delivery to over 1 300 cities.
• Fast delivery from 30 minutes or convenient in-store pickup.
• Pay with any international bank cards, or your favorite payment service.
THE #1 APP FOR ORDERING FLOWERS AND GIFTS
The Flowwow app topped Roskachestvo's ranking in the "Flowers and Gifts" app category.*
*Based on Roskachestvo's overall rating for "Flowers and Gifts (mobile apps)," published December 9, 2025: https://rskrf.ru/ratings/tekhnika-i-elektronika/mobilnye-prilozheniya/mp-tsvety-i-podarki/
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
CAN I ORDER A GIFT WITHOUT MAKING ANY CALLS?
Yes. Just pick a product, place your order in the app, and chat with the seller if you need to sort out any details.
HOW DO I ORDER DELIVERY TO ANOTHER CITY?
Enter the recipient's city, and the app will show you what's available near them.
HOW CAN I CHECK THE GIFT BEFORE IT'S DELIVERED?
Before dispatch, the seller sends you a photo of the finished order for your approval.
CAN I CHOOSE A DELIVERY TIME?
Yes. Depending on what the shop offers, you can schedule delivery for a specific time or choose express delivery.
IS A GRETTING CARD INCLUDED IN THE PRICE?
Yes. A branded greeting card is already included — just add your message.
CAN I PICK MY OWN CAKE FILLING?
Yes. Some items have additional options, including a choice of filling, which you can select directly on the item card.
HOW DO I PAY FOR MY ORDER?
You can pay for your Flowwow order using any international bank cards, as well as payment services.
Flowwow support: hello@flowwow.com

HANDS-ON SETUP & DEDICATED SUPPORT

bluejetty:00075618:ios.description:
An automatic counting app built for organizations with repetitive counting tasks, designed to be secure and private.
HANDS-ON SETUP & DEDICATED SUPPORT
While CountThings works out of the box for many organizations, every operational workflow is unique. Unlike typical self-serve apps where you are left on your own, our team is directly available to speak with you and ensure your deployment succeeds.
Contact us to create specialized Counting Templates for your specific items and environment, usually at no charge. Counting Templates are downloadable plugins that teach the app what to count.
Reach out anytime to schedule a live walkthrough, explore configuration options, or consult with our team on best practices for integrating the app into your operations.
FEATURE CONTROL
Easily include optional tools like reports, forms, integrations, or your corporate branding and logo.
Administrators can pre-configure user permissions and settings, so operators only see the specific screens, buttons, and visual elements needed for their repetitive counting tasks.
100% OFFLINE COUNTING
For privacy and security, all counting processes run directly on your device rather than over the internet. You can count items anywhere, even with no active network connection.
An internet connection is needed for initial setup, such as downloading Counting Templates, activating licenses, and syncing organization settings.
DIRECT EXPERT SUPPORT
Our technical team is readily available via video meetings to help you fine-tune the app for your operational needs and provide hands-on guidance for your workflow setup.
Contact us anytime at support@CountThings.com.

bluejetty:00063373:ios.name: Fleet Battle: Sea Battle PvP
bluejetty:00063373:ios.summary: Fleet Battle - this is what fast-paced naval combat looks like! The ultimate classic Sea Battle strategy board game for your smartphone. Striking visuals and immersive sound design meet timeless tactical combat. Play with friends, compete a
bluejetty:00063373:ios.description:
Fleet Battle - this is what fast-paced naval combat looks like! The ultimate classic Sea Battle strategy board game for your smartphone. Striking visuals and immersive sound design meet timeless tactical combat. Play with friends, compete against random opponents and sink their battleships - locally or worldwide - or relax with offline play.
Fleet Battle brings the beloved naval board game experience to mobile with unmatched tactical depth. Defeat ship after ship and rise through the ranks - from Seaman Recruit to Admiral of the Navy.
Pit yourself against the computer (Singleplayer), challenge real players around the world (Quick Match and Salvo) or battle with friends in private matches (Play with Friends). Enjoy 2 player games or worldwide multiplayer naval battles - prove you have the instincts of a true Fleet Commander.
If you're looking for a fun, fast-paced naval battleship-style combat game - look no further.
Key Features:
- Salvo Event: fast-paced competitive sea battle with an ELO ranking system
- Salvo Event: be rewarded with new nameplate effects and unique hitmarkers
- Quick Match: instant multiplayer battles against real players worldwide
- Leaderboards: enter the Hall of Champions
- Medals: earn match and leaderboard medals
- Play with Friends: Online / WiFi - battle at sea with friends anywhere
- Play with Friends Lobby: chat in global and language chats and make new friends
- Public and player-created tournaments: compete in 4-player or 8-player knockout tournaments (via Play with Friends)
- Play Singleplayer offline: no internet needed after first launch
- Game Modes: Standard, Classic or Russian mode
- Shot rules: Chainfire, Hitting Streak, Salvo or Multi Shot
- Daily Battles: complete daily challenges to unlock 22 historical battleships
- 3D warships: collect navy fleets from 13 different countries
- Ship skins: collect over 90 different skins per ship
- Personalize your profile with unlockable cosmetics
- Chat with parental control: chat with players from around the world
- Free voice-over audio packages in game options
- Free to download: the perfect sea battle experience
Imagine yourself in charge of the flight deck on the aircraft carrier, a common sailor on a submarine or patrol boat, gun crewman on an agile cruiser, sonar listener on a destroyer or the captain of a deadly battleship.
Do your duty on all the warships of your grand armada, take command of the naval forces at your disposal and place your boats in the perfect formation for war. Show off your tactical prowess and destroy the enemy flotilla with superior skill and decisive strikes.
Be prepared for combat, Commander!
Feeling bored?
Fleet Battle is a perfect time killer when travelling, during a school break or while waiting somewhere. Your pocket battleships are always ready to fight boredom. No internet available? No problem - play offline!
Play with friends, family or alone vs the computer. If you loved navy board games as a kid, Fleet Battle will bring back beloved childhood memories with modern multiplayer competition, naval warfare strategy and strategic depth.
When we created this adaptation of the classic Sea Battle boardgame we stayed close to the original while adding options and features rarely seen in this genre of strategy board games. Fleet Battle is a true flagship among naval warship games - free to play with real tactical depth.
We, the smuttlewerkers, two childhood friends, are humbled that millions of players around the world enjoy our game. THANK YOU to everyone who has been with us over the years.
Enjoy the game and don't shoot the fish!
The classic sea battle board game - play sea battle with friends or solo, online or offline.
Support: Problems or suggestions? We'd love to hear from you!
support@smuttlewerk.de | www.smuttlewerk.com

bluejetty:00184623:ios.description:
Ever wished A trip to a childhood dreamland of toys! MadOverGames welcomes you to the world of toys with a new colorful bubble shooter - Toys Pop! 
As the Makers of Frozen Pop, Gummy Pop, and Space Cats Pop, we present you with the nostalgic journey of classic bubble shooter and colorful word of toys. Toy pop takes you to the ultimate free balloon shooting adventure. Where you can match aim and burst balls with cute characters and high-quality animation. Take the incredible trip of these classic games with hundreds of puzzles and revisit the childhood dream of the toy world. 
Venture this best bubble shooter world and help Gugoo and his friends defeat Buggey man and bring back peace to their kingdom. With the help of your bubble shooting skills, simply match three or more bubbles and rescue the kingdom. Enjoy the balloon blast in funky locations like Kitchen, Bedroom, and Backyard, with relaxing animation and cute characters. With more than 5000 challenging levels and fun puzzles, this time-killing shooting game is the most addictive brain-teasing game. 
Join the battle of balloon blast game and win rewards and coins with every victory earned. Play the classic bubble shooter and unlock the power booster and bombs to blast and move up on the ladder of addictive ball blast levels. Enjoy the hours of a relaxing journey of aim, match, and burst unlimited balls with sweet, adorable characters. Burst colorful balls and solves addictive puzzles to train your brain in this toy land. 
Over hundreds of free levels filled with, this journey comes with powerups, bombs, etc. Venture on this brain-teasing mode and enjoy the happy ball fiesta to win coins. Connect to Facebook and let your friends and family be a part of this bubble burst shooting adventure! Connect and compete with family as well as friends and score high to become champion of the champions. 
Toys Pop features: 
- Easy to play - just match three or more bubbles to pop them 
- Shoot all the colorful bubbles and free cute little Teddies from BugeyMan's trap 
- Play in funky locations like Kitchen, Bedroom, Backyard, and more 
- Over 4 characters to choose from 
- Connect to Facebook to save your game progress & play with friends 
- Bomb, lightning, and more powerups to help you win 
- Play daily and win lots of free rewards 
- 5000 free levels with more added every month in the bubble pop

bluejetty:00184668:ios.name: TerraGenesis - Space Settlers
bluejetty:00184668:ios.summary:
Use real science from NASA to cultivate life on desolate planets. Think you have what it takes to bring a dead planet to life? Can you settle the stars?
Explore space and terraform new worlds in this immersive idle planet building simulat
bluejetty:00184668:ios.description:
Use real science from NASA to cultivate life on desolate planets. Think you have what it takes to bring a dead planet to life? Can you settle the stars?
Explore space and terraform new worlds in this immersive idle planet building simulator rooted in real science. TerraGenesis dynamically animates entire planets with changing biospheres, all based on real data from NASA.
The universe is your playground in TerraGenesis! With idle gameplay you can cultivate real planets in our solar system, planets created just for TerraGenesis and even alien worlds! When the world is in your hands, the possibilities are truly endless. If you’re a fan of astronomy, idle games, or resource management games, you will love Terragenesis! Download and start terraforming today!
BUILD A PLANET
- Join one of four interstellar Factions, each with different benefits for building interstellar settlements
- Build entire worlds one step at a time, by creating pressurized habitats for your settlers so they can survive in hostile environments
- Terraform your planet to support human life by managing specific resources of each world, including air pressure, oxygen, sea levels, and biomass
- Melt ice caps to create planet-wide oceans and seed the planet with life
- Track your civilization’s idle progress and your world’s current status with the Stats Summary Page
DISCOVER PLANETS & MOONS
- Learn astronomy and settle planets from our solar system, including Mercury, Venus, Earth & Mars!
- Terraform orbital satellites, including The Moon as well as the Moons of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune
- Build civilizations on fictional planets, including Bacchus, Ragnarok, Pontus, Lethe and Boreas
- Terraform Dwarf Planets, including Ceres, Pluto, Charon, Makemake, Eris and Sedna
- Discover lost secrets on Trappist-1 planets, including Damu, Aja, Huanca, Ruaumoko, Asintmah, Ostara, Aranyani
- Travel through time in the Historical Earths campaign, including Vaalbara, Rodinia, Cambria, Cretacea, Dania, Chibania, and Ultima
- Generate random worlds with complete surface and elevation maps, unique starting conditions and more
BIOSPHERE SIMULATOR
- Start with 26 different phyla and add 64 unique genes to create all kinds of amazing organisms to inhabit your world
- Manage your lifeforms as they thrive in both terrestrial and aquatic biospheres
ENCOUNTER ALIEN POPULATIONS
- Discover distant planets in outer space with thriving alien civilizations.
- Choose between making peace or conquering the alien lifeforms.
- Carry out dozens of missions and build your new world based on your alien strategy.
DEFEND FROM ASTEROIDS
- Save your civilization and protect your flourishing planet from the threat of an asteroid attack
- Build a planetary defense network to detect giant asteroids in space, initiate missions to destroy the threat, change the asteroid’s course or develop new strategies to survive certain doom.
BUILD YOUR OWN FLAT EARTH
- Insanity now comes with an on/off switch; flick a switch to turn existing worlds flat.
- Build a flat earth or build other flat planets from our solar system or throughout the universe!
- Hilarious random events unique to flat earth mode!
TerraGenesis is free to play and as an indie game; it was important to us that all in-app purchases are entirely optional and not required for a full and complete experience.
Enjoying TerraGenesis? Learn more!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TerraGenesisGame
Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/SettleTheStars
Terms of Use: http://www.tiltingpoint.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00062642:ios.summary: Explore, learn about, and document your geologic surroundings! Whether you are a professional geoscientist or curious about the rocks around you and the stories they tell, Rockd allows you to explore and learn about the geologic record, con
bluejetty:00062642:ios.description:
Explore, learn about, and document your geologic surroundings! Whether you are a professional geoscientist or curious about the rocks around you and the stories they tell, Rockd allows you to explore and learn about the geologic record, contribute your own observations, and log your journey through the geologic record. 
Features:
 - Instant access to geologic and geographic summaries of your current location via a Dashboard
 - Interactive global access to more than 290 geologic maps, with more being added weekly
 - Explore the landscape with a dynamic, 3D virtual globe
 - Save maps for use in the field with a built-in map caching system
 - See your past location and explore paleogeographic maps from C.R. Scotese and GPlates
 - View Macrostrat stratigraphic columns where available (beta)
 - Explore published literature containing mentions of mapped geologic units (when available) via xDD (formerly, GeoDeepDive)
 - Elevation data for most points on Earth from digital elevation models (DEMs)
 - Add your own field observations even offline; tag features from Macrostrat and the Paleobiology Database 
 - Record strike/dip or trend/plunge for geologic features, using your phone's compass
 - Track your progress through the geologic record privately, or share it with others 
 - See the public activity of other users and share your own and other public checkins using unique URLs
Rockd is produced by the Macrostrat lab in the Department of Geoscience at the University of Wisconsin - Madison. Support provided by the National Science Foundation (NSF) and the Dept. of Geoscience. 
Experiencing issues? Send an email to contact@rockd.org and we will do our best to help you resolve it.

listings.name: Rockd
listings.description:
Explore, learn about, and document your geologic surroundings! Whether you are a professional geoscientist or curious about the rocks around you and the stories they tell, Rockd allows you to explore and learn about the geologic record, contribute your own observations, and log your journey through the geologic record. 

Features:
  - Instant access to geologic and geographic summaries of your current location via a Dashboard
  - Interactive global access to more than 290 geologic maps, with more being added weekly
  - Explore the landscape with a dynamic, 3D virtual globe
  - Save maps for use in the field with a built-in map caching system
  - See your past location and explore paleogeographic maps from C.R. Scotese and GPlates
  - View Macrostrat stratigraphic columns where available (beta)
  - Explore published literature containing mentions of mapped geologic units (when available) via xDD (formerly, GeoDeepDive)
  - Elevation data for most points on Earth from digital elevation models (DEMs)
  - Add your own field observations even offline; tag features from Macrostrat and the Paleobiology Database 
  - Record strike/dip or trend/plunge for geologic features, using your phone's compass
  - Track your progress through the geologic record privately, or share it with others 
  - See the public activity of other users and share your own and other public checkins using unique URLs

Rockd is produced by the Macrostrat lab in the Department of Geoscience at the University of Wisconsin - Madison. Support provided by the National Science Foundation (NSF) and the Dept. of Geoscience. 

Experiencing issues? Send an email to contact@rockd.org and we will do our best to help you resolve it.

《新概念英语》1-4册全部内容都打包在应用里，可以离线使用，完全免费。
新概念英语（New Concept English）作为全世界最为经典的英语学习的宝典，以其严密的体系性、严谨的科学性、精湛的实用性、浓郁的趣味性深受英语学习者的青睐。
新概念英语（New Concept English）作为一套优秀的英语学习教材，多年来深受中国广大英语学习者的信赖，新概念英语自1997年改版以来，在教学方面增加了大量的情景对话，教学内容更趋向于科学性、实用性。旨在提高学生听、说、读、写的综合能力，学员经过一段时间系统的学习后，其英语水平将会得到全面提高和质的飞跃。
新概念第1册：(英语初阶)基础班
从 26 个英文字母、音标、语调开始学起，详细的介绍英语中的各种语法、句法、词法及句型结构知识，每篇课文内容均贴近现时生活的方方面面，其语言风趣幽默，每篇文章都配有漫画，文字形象生动。能极大的提高学生对英语的学习兴趣，练好第一册，是练好英语基本功的关键。
新概念第2册：(实践与进步)初级班
第二册是过渡，同时也是转变，它使学习者从一个会说日常英语的人，提高成为一个敢动笔进行基本写作的人。It is the very beginning of writing. 第二册以96 篇小故事为素材，培养学生听、说、读、写的基本能力，其优势在于扩充词汇量，统揽语法，结合实践，听说兼修。学完之后学习者能够运用地道句型与人进行交谈，其写作能力得到进一步提高
新概念第3册：(培养技能)提高班
掌握英语的关键(Developing Skills)着重分析句子之间内在的逻辑关系, 使你认识到句型的精炼、优美、实用与可模仿性, 从而将其有机地运用于英语写作之中;老师将进一步扩充讲解词汇、短语及语法的实战运用。已完成《新概念英语》第二册学习后可进行《新概念英语》第三册的学习。
新概念第4册：(流利英语)高级班
体味英语的精髓(Fluency in English)四册涵盖了文化、经济、哲学、艺术、体育、政治、美学、心理学、社会学、教育学、伦理学、天文学等三十多个学科门类, 语言文字精美独到, 句型结构复杂多变而又不失简洁酣畅。同时诸多文章里蕴涵着深厚的哲思、美学及西方文化中独特的思维方式, 这使得该教材成为每一位欲真正掌握英语语言精华的学习者不可多得、不可不学的教材。

新概念英语 全四册提供同步点读和同步练习，不仅有英汉对照、同步点读等基础功能，还提供了极为强大的学习功能，是AppStore上最好用的新概念学习应用。

同时我们提供多种主题颜色，让您自主选择，还提供完美的语速调节让您听得更清学得更快。

我们逐字逐句校对的内容完全与《新概念英语》教材同步，请放心使用。

同时我们精心校对了第一册双数课的课文与录音，同样以中英双语的形式呈现给您，只为你更好的学习英语。

 iPhone 和 iPad横竖屏完美适配

《新概念英语》1-4册全部内容都打包在应用里，可以离线使用，完全免费。


新概念英语（New Concept English）作为全世界最为经典的英语学习的宝典，以其严密的体系性、严谨的科学性、精湛的实用性、浓郁的趣味性深受英语学习者的青睐。

新概念英语（New Concept English）作为一套优秀的英语学习教材，多年来深受中国广大英语学习者的信赖，新概念英语自1997年改版以来，在教学方面增加了大量的情景对话，教学内容更趋向于科学性、实用性。旨在提高学生听、说、读、写的综合能力，学员经过一段时间系统的学习后，其英语水平将会得到全面提高和质的飞跃。


新概念第1册：(英语初阶)基础班
从 26 个英文字母、音标、语调开始学起，详细的介绍英语中的各种语法、句法、词法及句型结构知识，每篇课文内容均贴近现时生活的方方面面，其语言风趣幽默，每篇文章都配有漫画，文字形象生动。能极大的提高学生对英语的学习兴趣，练好第一册，是练好英语基本功的关键。

新概念第2册：(实践与进步)初级班
第二册是过渡，同时也是转变，它使学习者从一个会说日常英语的人，提高成为一个敢动笔进行基本写作的人。It is the very beginning of writing. 第二册以96 篇小故事为素材，培养学生听、说、读、写的基本能力，其优势在于扩充词汇量，统揽语法，结合实践，听说兼修。学完之后学习者能够运用地道句型与人进行交谈，其写作能力得到进一步提高

新概念第3册：(培养技能)提高班
掌握英语的关键(Developing Skills)着重分析句子之间内在的逻辑关系, 使你认识到句型的精炼、优美、实用与可模仿性, 从而将其有机地运用于英语写作之中;老师将进一步扩充讲解词汇、短语及语法的实战运用。已完成《新概念英语》第二册学习后可进行《新概念英语》第三册的学习。

新概念第4册：(流利英语)高级班
体味英语的精髓(Fluency in English)四册涵盖了文化、经济、哲学、艺术、体育、政治、美学、心理学、社会学、教育学、伦理学、天文学等三十多个学科门类, 语言文字精美独到, 句型结构复杂多变而又不失简洁酣畅。同时诸多文章里蕴涵着深厚的哲思、美学及西方文化中独特的思维方式, 这使得该教材成为每一位欲真正掌握英语语言精华的学习者不可多得、不可不学的教材。

bluejetty:00121130:ios.summary:
ONE OM NOM. SEVEN SIDEKICKS. COUNTLESS PUZZLES

Along the way,
bluejetty:00121130:ios.description:
ONE OM NOM. SEVEN SIDEKICKS. COUNTLESS PUZZLES
In his unexpected adventure, Om Nom breaks out of his box and travels through lush forests, busy cities, junkyards and underground tunnels, all in pursuit of one goal – CANDY! 
Along the way, he encounters the Nommies, the cutest candy collecting helpers a little green monster could wish for! 
WHAT'S INSIDE:
• 196 physics-based puzzle levels of candy collecting, rope cutting action
• Super satisfying physics-based gameplay
• Fast-paced, addictive single-player brain teasers
• Hilarious cartoons about Om Nom “Om Nom Stories”
• Play offline anywhere, anytime
• Fun for all ages, from kids to the young at heart
MEET OM NOM’S NEW FRIENDS, THE NOMMIES!
• Roto can carry Om Nom to the best candy catching locations
• Lick can make small bridges with his tongue to help Om Nom reach his goal
• Blue can lift Om Nom to new levels of candy hunting fun
• Toss can throw objects, including candy
• Boo can scare Om Nom to jump to new heights
• Snailbrow bravely rolls on walls and ceilings and pushes candies around, like a boss
• Ginger can burn away obstacles between Om Nom and the candy
THREE WAYS TO PLAY EVERY PUZZLE:
One puzzle means three chances to shine!
Each level comes with fun twists on the same setup:
• Solve the puzzle and feed Om Nom
• Collect the fruit while pulling off the same trick
• Beat the clock to snag two stars in time
Clear all three to earn every medal and show that you can solve tasks fast, smart, and of course sweet!
HOW TO PLAY:
• Cut ropes to deliver candy to Om Nom
• Let Nommies' special abilities help you solve the puzzles
• Use power-ups to tackle tricky levels
• Collect stars and gain coins to get power-ups, new hats and sweets for Om Nom and new finger traces for yourself!
So what are you waiting for? Join Om Nom's adventure, help a cute little monster out, and boost your brainpower with fun, clever, physics-based puzzle challenges now! 
Cut the Rope 2 is free to download and play, however, some in-game items can be purchased for real money. For more information, please see our Terms of Use (https://www.zeptolab.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.zeptolab.com/privacy)

bluejetty:00088097:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00088097:ios.description:
Nowadays playing games can often be stressful than relaxing…
So why not play this whenever you feel like relaxing and befriending cats?
Craft items/furniture the kitties love!
Craft them one by one, and the most adorable kitties will appear… maybe…
Relax, kick back and enjoy the game!
Then, once you become friends with the cats,
you can witness their special behaviors :)
Befriend as many cats as possible, and complete your own album!
You can download the album images to use as your PC or Mobile wallpaper!
■ Features
- Easy to play, intuitive controls!
- Day/Night cycle (real-time)
- Dozens of adorable kitties
- The cutest animations
- Gorgeous moving backgrounds
- Linked to Game Center
■ How to play
1. Craft "Furniture" cats love
2. Use the fishing rod to fill up the "Fish"
3. "Turn off screen" rest up and coming back later
4. Cat Appeared!!
- Tap the tree on the right, collect wood and build furniture!
- Go fishing to fill up your fish inventory. Every time cats visit, they'll gobble up your fish.
- You'll acquire items through fishing or kitty's gifts. Upgrade using these items!
- Swipe from the right corner of the screen (like flipping pages in a book) to go to "Archive".
- Complete your Archives to acquire a Special Album.
- Use Furniture Collection when you're out of woods!
※ Craft secret furniture (Gold?) to discover a new place!
■ Cloud Save
- Saved to cloud, not a server. Save/link your data to Game Center to keep your progress safe.
- Setting > Apple ID > iCloud > iCloud Drive "ON"
****** IMPORTANT ******
- Make sure the device time is [Set Automatically]. If you change the device time manually, game data may be permanently deleted.
****** FAQ ******
Q. I tried fishing, but didn't get any items.
A. Once you've acquired all the items (Shards, Assembly Parts), you can no longer get any items.
Q. I used an Archive Shard, but the blank spaces still remain.
A. When you use an Archive Shard, only 1 blank space will be removed.
Q. I've completed the Profile Archive, but I'm still getting Shards!
A. There are extra Shards in the game (Around 20.) If you get more than 20,
find out which secret furniture (Gold?!) is waiting for you, and use shards to craft it!
※ This game was created with the support of the Seoul Business Agency (SBA)

bluejetty:00114205:ios.description:
Wayk is an alarm clock built to help you actually get out of bed. Instead of tapping snooze and falling back asleep, you wake up with a mission that must be completed before the alarm turns off.
Wayk is made for people who struggle to wake up, hit snooze too often, or want a stronger morning routine. It turns waking up into action so you can start the day with purpose and momentum.
How Wayk works:
1) Choose a mission before bed
2) When the alarm rings, complete the task
3) The alarm only stops when the mission is done
Mission examples:
- Do pushups
- Take a photo of the sky
- Make your bed
- Find a random object
- Read a Bible verse
- Read an affirmation aloud
Why people use Wayk:
- Stop snoozing and get up faster
- Build a more consistent morning routine
- Add accountability to your wake-up time
- Start the day with discipline and purpose
- Turn your alarm into a daily win
More than just an alarm clock:
- Mission-based wake-up system
- Built for heavy snoozers and people who struggle with mornings
- Track streaks and morning insights
- Set unlimited alarms
- Great for anyone trying to improve discipline, routine, and productivity
SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED
After you complete the short setup questions, an active Wayk Pro subscription is required to set alarms and use missions.
If you have any ideas or questions, please email us at hello@wayk.io.

[App Permission Guide]
This application may request the following access permissions depending on the connected device model and the specific features you use.
【Required Permissions】
Permissions essential for this application. If you decline to grant any of the following permissions, you will be unable to use the basic features of this application.
None
【Optional Permissions】
These permissions are required for additional features of this application. You may decline to grant the following permissions. Your refusal will not affect your continued use of other features and services of this application. However, the use of certain features that require such permissions may be restricted.
Local Network
Used to discover compatible devices on the local network for device setup and control.
Used to support device network configuration, AP direct connection, and local device control.
Bluetooth
Used to scan, discover, connect to, and control Bluetooth devices for pairing, operation, and firmware updates.
Camera
Used to scan QR codes for device setup and login, and to handle feedback, floor plan uploads, and plugin or camera features.
Microphone
Used to support video intercom on smart devices and capture audio for voice commands.
Location
Used to identify region for localized environment info, scan Wi-Fi networks, and record exercise routes with improved accuracy.
Photos
Used to select and upload local photos or videos for feedback, floor plans, and plugin or camera features.
Notifications
Used to provide users with notifications regarding device status and related information.
HomeKit
Used to support the synchronization, pairing, and control of HomeKit devices within Xiaomi Home.

bluejetty:00033007:ios.name: Crozzle - Crossword Puzzles
bluejetty:00033007:ios.summary:
Upgrade your daily brain training, crossword style! Play the word puzzle game that bumps the classic daily crossword puzzle up to a new level of word fun with strategy, competition and tons of surprises. Play is the new way to crossword!
Fe
bluejetty:00033007:ios.description:
Upgrade your daily brain training, crossword style! Play the word puzzle game that bumps the classic daily crossword puzzle up to a new level of word fun with strategy, competition and tons of surprises. Play is the new way to crossword!
Feel smarter after every play as you solve clever clues and rack up points word by word. And don’t forget to relax between daily brain workouts!
Crozzle is the daily crossword puzzle you know and love, only better. Crossword + game = way more fun! We’ve gamified the classic daily crossword puzzle, so going that extra mile making words in your daily brain workout is a game, not a chore.
Each game is a puzzle you solve against an opponent! Take turns adding all the letters you can until the puzzle is solved. Crossword skills are a must, but you’ll also need strategy to win. Brain boosting fun right?! Here’s how the game works:
How to Play
• Play a 1-on-1 crossword match versus an opponent
• Add as many of your letters as you can to the puzzle, then it’s your opponent’s turn
• Earn points for correctly placed letters
• Earn more points for completed words
• Earn even more points for placing letters on bonus squares!
• Once all the words in a puzzle are solved, the player with the most points wins!
Pretty simple eh? Here’s some fun, brain busting twists!
Fun Features
• Fun picture clues + clever brain-training word clues
• Multiply points by placing letters in words on bonus squares
• Swap out letters you don’t want to play for new ones! (costs gems)
• Gain advantage with boosters like wild tile, double bonus, more letters (cost gems)
• Unlock hidden clues for words in fun daily Events!
Strategy sets Crozzle apart from other crosswords. The more words you play, the better your word puzzle skills and the better you’ll get at outscoring opponents.
The fun doesn’t stop there. You don’t have to leave the game to relax and give your brain a break between daily crossword workouts!
Open the Crozzle Map to visit dreamy destinations! Whether it’s beautiful city parks, cafes and museums, tropical island getaways or fun mountain adventures, the Crozzle Map has you covered.
There’s a million reasons for crossword lovers to play this unique new word puzzle game. If you’re a wiz with words, curious about crosswords and love brain training word games, here’s some more reasons to play!
Why You’ll Love Crozzle
• Thousands of quick, solvable puzzles
• Play words at your own pace, no timer!
• Challenge hard opponents
• Earn coins and gems with wins and frequent play
• Get game-boosting goodies in the shop
• Climb event leaderboards
Brain train with the best and scratch your daily crossword itch with the smartest word puzzle game around. Stay sharp the fun way with Crozzle.
Next level crossword fun!

bluejetty:00086585:ios.description:
MONEY DÜNYASINA HOŞ GELDİN!
Money ile Migros alışverişlerinden yan hak bakiyelerine, fatura ödemelerinden yatırıma kadar tüm ihtiyaçların tek uygulamada.
Migros kasasında QR ile saniyeler içinde öde, Money Yemek dahil tüm bakiyelerini tek ekrandan yönet, sana özel kampanyaları keşfet ve MoneyPay ile para transferini kolayca yap. Tüm bunlar Money ile çok kolay!
Migros'ta QR ile Hızlı Öde
Cüzdanını yanına almana gerek yok: Migros kasasında QR kodu okut, ödemen saniyeler içinde tamamlansın. Masterpass altyapısıyla kredi kartını bir kez kaydet; mağazada, Migros uygulamasında ve QR ödemelerinde zahmetsizce kullan.
Tüm Bakiyelerin Tek Ekranda
TL Bakiye, Money Pro, Money ProFlex, Money Yemek, Money Yemek Flex, MigrosPara ve Money Puan... Şirketinin sağladığı tüm yan hak bakiyelerini tek ekrandan gör, dilediğin gibi harca.
Money Yemek Bakiyen Artık Money'de
Money Yemek ve Money Yemek Flex bakiyelerini uygulamadan takip et, anlaşmalı restoranlarda QR ile öde. Money Yemek Flex bakiyeni restoranların yanı sıra Migros'taki gıda alışverişlerinde de kullanabilirsin.
7/24 Para Transferi Yap
Para transferlerini günün her saati hızlıca gerçekleştir. MoneyPay hesabına Migros kasalarından, kartlarınla veya EFT ile para yükle; ihtiyacın olduğunda çek.
Money Kartlarınla Dilediğin Yerde Öde
Troy altyapılı MoneyPay ön ödemeli kartınla istediğin yerde güvenle alışveriş yap, harcadıkça kazan.
Faturalarını Tek Tıkla Öde
Su, elektrik, doğalgaz, TV ve internet faturalarını MoneyPay ile hızlıca öde, zamandan tasarruf et.
Altın, Gümüş ve Platine Yatırım Yap
Yatırımını yastık altında değil, parmak ucunda tut. Altın, gümüş ve platin gibi kıymetli madenlerle birikimlerini değerlendir.
Alışveriş ve İhtiyaç Kredisi
İş birliği yaptığımız kurumların sunduğu alışveriş ve ihtiyaç kredisi seçenekleriyle planladığın harcamaları kolayca yap.
Money'i hemen indir, yorumlarını bizimle paylaş! Uygulamamızı senin geri bildirimlerinle her gün daha iyi hale getiriyoruz.

bluejetty:00051903:ios.summary:
Station Jam is a puzzle game that combines relaxation, strategic challenges, and immersive experiences, allowing you to experience a sense of accomplishment and joy as you coordinate vehicles and passengers perfectly. 
This station congest
bluejetty:00051903:ios.description:
Station Jam is a puzzle game that combines relaxation, strategic challenges, and immersive experiences, allowing you to experience a sense of accomplishment and joy as you coordinate vehicles and passengers perfectly. 
This station congestion game is not only a classic puzzle game but also has unique features that make it more realistic. Crowds of people flow through the station, and vehicles are lined up neatly like soldiers in review. You need to arrange vehicles of the same color in order according to the color of the passengers, which undoubtedly increases the challenge of the game. To safely transport all passengers, you need to establish an overall view, strategically plan every step, move all vehicles from the parking lot in the correct order, and pick up all passengers to successfully complete the level.
The game features a variety of levels with increasing difficulty, unique vehicle and passenger types, adding to the fun of the game. Beautiful graphics and sound effects create an immersive experience. Come and challenge your wisdom, experience the sense of accomplishment of coordinating vehicles and passengers perfectly!
Relax and de-stress, train your mind: It can both relax your mind and train your strategic thinking, making you think outside the box.
Realistic and challenging: Simulates real-life station scenarios, with passengers and vehicles lined up in an orderly manner, testing players' strategy and arrangement skills.
Diverse levels, gradual upgrades: Features a variety of levels with increasing difficulty, and unique obstacles are set to increase the fun of the game.
Beautiful graphics and immersive experience: Beautiful graphics and sound effects create an immersive gaming experience.

'Connector' app allow you to control your motorized window coverings more freely on smartphone. Please configure your 'Connector' APP account, Bridge and motorized window coverings on 'Connector' APP before use. 
With 'Connector' App, you
bluejetty:00040967:ios.description:
'Connector' app allow you to control your motorized window coverings more freely on smartphone. Please configure your 'Connector' APP account, Bridge and motorized window coverings on 'Connector' APP before use. 
With 'Connector' App, you can:
- Control up to 30 motorized window coverings
- Control up to 20 rooms
- Control up to 20 scenes
- Control up to 20 timers
After linking up your 'Connector' APP account with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant, you can directly open, close or percentage control by voice commands on all the motorized window coverings such as roller blinds, draperies, venetians..etc. You can activate independent shades or the scenes created in the 'Connector' App which has been synchronized with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant flexibly and conveniently to reach sunlight control and room management.
'Connector Bridge' is a WiFi to RF bi-directional controller with integrated RS485 interface. It builds a connection via user's WiFi router at home and enable user to control motorized window covering and sunshading products with designated smartphone applications and interaction with ecosystem such as Alexa Echo, Google Assistant via cloud API. The RS485 interface offers additional integration option into a third party home automation systems.

Get Ready for Nonstop Laughter with Headbands: Party & Group Games!

Turn any gathering into an unforgettable blast with Charades Headbands - the ultimate party game that delivers endless laughs and excitement! Perfect for game nights, family get-togethers, or team-building events, this interactive challenge will have everyone roaring with laughter as they act, describe, and guess their way to victory.

How to Play:

Each player wears a headband with a mystery word or phrase they can’t see. Teammates give clues through wild gestures or creative descriptions - but no peeking! Race against the clock to guess as many cards as possible, with every round packed with hilarious moments and friendly competition.

Why It’s a Must-Have:

Fun for Everyone - Easy to learn and play, perfect for all ages and group sizes.
Variety of Themes - Choose from categories like Movies, Animals, Jobs, Food & Drink, Cartoons, and even special decks like 90s Throwbacks or Sports Teams.
Customizable Gameplay - Add your own inside jokes or personalized prompts for a unique twist.
Perfect for Any Event - Whether it’s a birthday, holiday party, or casual hangout, this game keeps the energy high and the fun flowing.

Grab your friends, put on your headbands, and let the good times roll with Charades Headbands - where every round is a fresh dose of fun!

bluejetty:00165188:ios.description:
Welcome to Magic Craft, the mysterious magic shop!
[Craft magical items]
Merge various magic materials to create magic items. Merge mystical herbs in a glass vial into a magic potion! Merge parchment with the power of magic mushrooms to create a dark magic scroll. But no need to stop there...! Create beautiful magic costumes, colorful magic equipment, and even delicious magic food as well! How many different magic items can YOU create?
[Run a magic shop]
Knock knock! Customers are lining up outside Magic Craft, so make sure they're satisfied with the finest magic items! Grow your shop to discover new hidden magic recipes and sell even more amazing high-end magic items!
[Decorate your Magicka School]
Clack clack clack! Decorate the rooms of mages with a variety of magic furniture. As your school grows, you'll meet new mages and learn interesting stories about the mage world from them!
[Mage Collection]
Shh! The Magic Collection is a must for any aspiring mage! Gather collections to learn the unknown stories of the mages and experience the secret mage world with the collection pieces. Best of all, you get rewards for doing so!
[A mysterious world of magic]
Sparkle sparkle! You might need a magic potion to venture into the hidden mage world! Or a magic scroll to unleash powerful spells, or some magic food to fill your belly? Oh, and don't forget to pack your magic cloak! You can set off into the magical world any time you like!
Magic Craft is waiting for you!!
- For people interested in fun new stories from the mage world!
- For people looking for something to play during short breaks!
- For people with an undying love for merge games!
- For people who can't get enough of character customization and room decorating games!
- For people who can't help but smile when they see something cute and cuddly!
- For people with pure and wonderful hearts!

bluejetty:00147431:ios.name: Kinlia
bluejetty:00147431:ios.summary:
Find your people. Build community. Go to events that matter.
Kinlia helps you discover meaningful, connection-driven events in New York City, Los Angeles, and the Bay Area. From dance and wellness to art, music, and conscious gatherings — K
bluejetty:00147431:ios.description:
Find your people. Build community. Go to events that matter.
Kinlia helps you discover meaningful, connection-driven events in New York City, Los Angeles, and the Bay Area. From dance and wellness to art, music, and conscious gatherings — Kinlia brings together people who care about showing up, participating, and building real community.
No spectators here. Just people who want to connect.
On Kinlia, you’ll find a curated mix of creative, conscious, dance, nerdy, wellness-focused, and community-centered events — including:
• Movement & dance: Ecstatic dance, conscious raves, community-centered EDM, 5Rhythms, contact improv, acro yoga, embodiment practices
• Healing & mindfulness: Sound healing, meditation, breathwork, ceremony, integration circles
• Nature & community: Nature walks, hikes, outdoor gatherings
• Creativity & self-expression: Art salons, music jams, poetry nights, storytelling, crafting, flow arts
• Talks & workshops: Spirituality, activism, tech, self-growth, communication, culture, politics
• Festivals, retreats & immersive experiences: Conscious parties, themed gatherings, immersive art, transformational festivals, wellness retreats
We partner with community builders and event organizers to make it easy to find events where you belong — and to deepen connections with the people you meet there.
Are you an event organizer building community?
List your events at www.kinlia.com or directly through the Kinlia mobile app.
We’d love to support you through Kinlia’s built-in ticketing system, which offers:
• Immediate payouts
• Free email and SMS messages to ticket holders
• Simple event management
• Marketing support to help you grow your audience
Whether you’re looking for friendship, collaboration, creative inspiration, shared experiences, or authentic networking, Kinlia helps you meet people who feel aligned with you.
Kinlia welcomes everyone.
All genders, sexualities, relationship styles, belief systems, and life stages are welcome.
Our values are authenticity, kindness, creativity, play, community, and personal growth — and we invite you to live those values with us.
Kinlia is a product of Kindra Connect, Inc.
We’re using technology to deepen human connection and help communities thrive.

bluejetty:00122708:ios.description:
Let’s bring the bank to YOU! 
The FAB Mobile app puts the power of the bank in your hand. Spend, save and stay on top of your everyday banking from just about anywhere. 
DOWNLOAD. REGISTER. DONE!
If you’re a FAB customer or using the app on a new device, here’s how you can get started once you download the app:
• Tap ‘Already a customer’ and enter your credit or debit card number or customer number
• Tap and scan your Emirates ID
• Do the face scan as prompted – to ensure that only you have access to your account
• You’re done! Now you can start banking anywhere, anytime. 
NEW CUSTOMER? NO PROBLEM!
Start your journey with FAB right from your living room. Simply download the app and open an account, get a credit card or get approved for a personal loan – without stepping into a branch. You only need an Emirates ID. 
YOUR MONEY. YOUR WAY.
We know you value your time, so we’ve made sure you can do a whole lot of your banking, whenever you want. Here are some of things you can do:
• View your balance and e-statements
• Activate your card
• Pay your utility bills
• Get an Easy Payment Plan 
• Sign up for Islamic accounts
• Earn and redeem FAB Rewards
• Start an iSave and enjoy a higher rate of interest
• Upload your account documents – passport, visa, Emirates ID
• Login with Fingerprint or Face ID
• Locate your nearest FAB branch or ATM
• Enjoy free and instant transfers to India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Philippines 
• Enjoy exciting offers and exclusive discounts

bluejetty:00149922:ios.name: Maxwell Health Mobile
bluejetty:00149922:ios.summary: If your employer provides you access to Maxwell Health, the Maxwell mobile app makes it easy for you to enroll in, update and access your benefits any time, anywhere. With just a few taps, you can view important details like policy number,
bluejetty:00149922:ios.description:
If your employer provides you access to Maxwell Health, the Maxwell mobile app makes it easy for you to enroll in, update and access your benefits any time, anywhere. With just a few taps, you can view important details like policy number, member IDs, deductibles, and more. Whether you’re at home, at the doctor, traveling, or anywhere else life takes you, keep your health and other insurance info with you wherever you go. 
What you can do with the app:
Maxwell Health brings all your employer’s benefit information together in one place. If your employer uses Maxwell Health to help you choose and enroll in your benefits, you can access everything you typically manage online directly in the Maxwell mobile app. 
Shop for your benefits. Login through your maxwell mobile app to choose and enroll in your benefits quickly and simply. With Maxwell, it’s easy to understand coverage, compare across plans, and select the benefits that make sense for you and your family.
View your benefits on the go. Access your coverage details for benefits like medical, dental, vision, life, disability and healthcare spending accounts.
Need to make changes? Open up Maxwell to make important updates to benefits when life events happen, like moving off your parent’s coverage, getting married, or having a baby.
Get a full financial view. Keep a pulse on your monthly and per pay period benefit costs.
Looking for guidance and support? Reach out to your employer’s benefits advisor or HR administrator for help with your benefits right through the app.
About Maxwell Health:
Maxwell Health is an HR and benefits platform focused on simplifying and modernizing the benefits experience to make care and benefits easier. Maxwell Health is owned by Sun Life Financial. 
Note: You must have a Maxwell Health account through your employer to access the Maxwell mobile app.

Introducing Shroomy: your very own stress sidekick!
Shroomy is a self care companion who helps support your daily wellbeing:
- Make self care a habit: Every day Shroomy designs you a simple, self care plan to help you build your mental resilience over time.
- Get support, 24/7: Talk to Shroomy whenever you're feeling worried or overwhelmed, and receive personalised exercises to help you feel better.
- Suggestions as unique as you are: Shroomy remembers everything you've shared, and responds to you accordingly.
- Get to know yourself: Over time you'll unlock insights about yourself, so you can deepen your self awareness.
Try Shroomy free for 7 days. A subscription is required to continue using the app after the trial period.
Shroomy is private. All stored data is kept on your device.
Disclaimer: Shroomy is a wellness and self-care tool. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical or mental-health condition, and it is not a substitute for therapy, counselling, or other professional care. All guidance and insights are for personal reflection only. If you feel unsafe or have concerns about your mental health, please consult a qualified healthcare provider or call your local emergency services.

bluejetty:00023640:ios.name: Phoenix Classroom
bluejetty:00023640:ios.summary: Phoenix Classroom is an end-to-end Learning Management System (LMS) connecting students, teachers, and parents. Specifically designed by educators having decades of experience, it has all the resources needed to ensure continuity of best-in
bluejetty:00023640:ios.description:
Phoenix Classroom is an end-to-end Learning Management System (LMS) connecting students, teachers, and parents. Specifically designed by educators having decades of experience, it has all the resources needed to ensure continuity of best-in-class teaching and learning experience. Catering to multi-curricula such as British, IB, American, India and National it is used by a large number of parents and their students in UAE and across the region. Classroom mobile is an intuitive app with a host of features and functionalities required for all the stakeholders (teachers, students & parents) to enable learning and collaboration on-the-go.
Some of the salient features of the app are:
For Teachers
• Deliver live (synchronous) lessons that are fully embedded with advanced features
• Perform a host of administrative tasks such as mark attendance, track students’ behavior, monitor overall progress and collaborate with parents and students
For Students
• Access customized lessons, including digital content and assessments. Submit assignments and quizzes online
• Use Chatter platform to participate in discussions with teachers and peers
For Parents
• View grades, achievements, reports and track overall student progress under a unified umbrella
• Keep track of school news as well as class and group announcements, perform admin activities such as online fees payment, raise leave requests, service requests etc.

bluejetty:00135605:ios.description:
Overwinter Survival is a card-based survival game in which you are stranded on the glaciers of Greenland.
The cold and loneliness ensnare you after your plane breaks down for an unknown reason, leaving you crashed on Greenland's glaciers and seeking shelter at a nearby cabin. Now you must hunt, craft tools and items, and keep your stove fueled to survive in the cold.
In Overwinter Survival, you must use the cards you're dealt to stay alive. You can only use one card per round. With Lady Luck at the helm, no two journeys will be the same.
Fish in the glaciers, hunt with your spear and craft an axe at your workshop to become a lumberjack. To get out of this frozen hell and see your family once again, you must stay alive and repair your plane. 
Experience a unique journey each time you play with randomly generated card decks and test your survival skills while pushing your luck amidst the frozen glaciers.
