Matriks Mobil IQ
Canlı borsa, kript
bluejetty:00068497:ios.description:
Finans piyasalarıyla ilgili güncel bilgileri her gün takip etmek için 1 numaralı finans destinasyonu olan Matriks’in yenilenen Matriks Mobil IQ uygulamasını kullanan yüz binlerce yatırımcıdan biri olun!
Matriks Mobil IQ
Canlı borsa, kripto paralar, altın fiyatları, döviz fiyatları, yabancı borsa endeksleri, haberler, piyasa analizleri, gelişmiş grafik özellikleri ile finansal piyasaları gerçek zamanlı takip edip, BIST Pay ve VIOP piyasalarında işlem yapmanızı sağlayan uygulamadır. 
Finansal Piyasalara İlişkin Fiyat ve Haber Takibi Cebinizde
Kişiselleştirilebilen ve kayıt edilebilen birden fazla izleme ekranı üzerinden, ilgilendiğiniz enstrümanları farklı sayfa görüntüleme ayarlarıyla takip edebilirsiniz. İzleme listenizdeki sembolleri sıcaklık haritası ve hızlı al/sat listesi olarak izleyebilir ve tek dokunuşla emir gönderebilirsiniz. 
Hazır piyasa listeleri ile BIST Pay, VIOP, Endeks, Varant, Döviz, Altın, Kripto Para, Faiz, Yabancı Borsa Endeksleri gibi finansal piyasalara ait enstrümanları kolayca takip edebilirsiniz. 
Fiyat alarmı kurabilir, takip ettiğiniz enstrümanlar beklediğiniz seviyelere geldiğinde uyarılar alabilirsiniz.
Finansal piyasalara ilişkin haberleri, yorumları ve şirket duyurularını anlık olarak takip edebilirsiniz. Fiyat izleme ekranlarındayken haber takibi yapabilirsiniz. Haberlerde arama ve filtreleme yaparak ilgilendiğiniz haberlere hızlıca ulaşabilirsiniz. Beklediğiniz haberler için alarm kurabilir, bildirimler ile alarmlarınız gerçekleştiğinde anında haberdar olabilirsiniz. Ekonomik Takvim verileri üzerinden piyasalarla ilgili gelişmeleri, açıklanacak verileri ülke seçimi ve önem derecesine göre filtreleyerek takip edebilirsiniz. 
Gelişmiş Analizlerle Piyasaları Daha İyi Yorumlayın
Borsada işlem gören şirketlerin bilanço, şirket kartı, takas, sermaye artırımı gibi bilgilerine kolayca ulaşarak analiz yapabilirsiniz. bluejetty:00185072:ios.description:
Looking for the most comprehensive software solution for flight simulation? Navigraph Charts is your co-pilot. 
Navigraph Charts 8 has been developed with emphasis on delivering a seamless and intuitive experience, reducing the pilot workload in all phases of the simulated flight.
Why you'll always want Navigraph Charts with you in the cockpit: 
- Only provider of Jeppesen charts and navigation data for flight simulation.
- Access to IFR chart coverage at over 7,000 airports worldwide. 
- Charts and data sourced from Jeppesen and updated every 28 days according to the AIRAC calendar.
- Largest dataset of its kind in the world.
- Most up-to-date and modern navigation software for flight simulation.
- Simulator sceneries, flight plans, charts, navigation systems, and addon software are all in sync with data from the same source.
- Great support. 
New features in Navigraph Charts 8:
- Worldwide VFR Charts powered by Jeppesen VFR data
- Seamless Zoom
- 3D Globe Projection
- Autopinning of Procedure Charts
- Runway Crosswind and Airport Weather Information
- Vector Charts
- Weather overlays including radar and winds
- ATIS
- NOTAM
- Annotate and draw on charts and SimBrief operational flight plan
- VATSIM and IVAO traffic and ATC sector display
Navigraph Unlimited features: 
- Moving Maps
- Zoom all the way down to gate level.
- 3D globe projection helps visualize Great Circle distances and polar routes.
- Saves time and effort by automatically organizing relevant airport charts to pinboard.
- Weather information including runway crosswinds updated in real-time.
- No commitment - cancel any time you like.
Moving Maps compatible with Microsoft Flight Simulator, X-Plane and Prepar3d.

Short, focused sessions make daily pilates realistic.

bluejetty:00088309:ios.description:
Take paid surveys, shop online, & engage in other money making online tasks to cash out!
InboxDollars is the app that pays you for your opinion. Answer questions for money - at home or on the go. Wherever you go and whenever you're free, choose a survey that looks interesting to you by selecting the ideal survey length, topic, and award amount. 
You'll earn rewards in dollars and cents, not points or other virtual currency. InboxDollars surveys are easy and straightforward - both to answer and to claim your survey winnings. 
Your opinion can make a difference in the products and services you love. Share your opinion with paid surveys for real cash. Share your thoughts on new products, Super Bowl ads, slogans, or even what price you think new shoe styles from internationally known brands should be. Join InboxDollars now for free and get a $5 Welcome Bonus. Install the free app. Sign up for free and complete the short profile survey (about 2 minutes) to get your free $5 bonus. 
TAKE PAID SURVEYS
InboxDollars is the top app for paid surveys, fun polls, and quizzes. Earn a cash payout for every survey you complete. You can answer online surveys from your smartphone in the InboxDollars Surveys app or on the website at InboxDollars.com. 
InboxDollars has hundreds of market research partners and can connect you with the best surveys for cash and free gift cards. Take surveys on various consumer topics, like politics, new TV shows, new potato chip flavors, or car commercials. 
With many surveys, you can get a sneak peek at new products or product versions that major brands are working on.
GET CASH BACK AND FREE GIFT CARDS 
InboxDollars is the Minnesota-based money-making app that really does pay. Since 2000, InboxDollars has paid over $70 million in free cash and gift card rewards. Over 1,000 free gift cards are redeemed every day by InboxDollars members. 
You can redeem your InboxDollars earnings for free PayPal cash, free Amazon gift cards, or gift cards to other popular stores and brands like Apple, Target, Mastercard, Amex, Walmart, Starbucks, Home Depot, eBay, and many more.
And when you shop online at your favorite stores with gift cards, you can earn even more. Earn cash back rebates from InboxDollars at 1,000+ popular stores. 
CHECK OUT ALL THE MONEY-MAKING DEALS 
Make sure to explore all the money-making deals that InboxDollars has to offer. 
- Get Cash Back on your grocery & convenience store shopping trips. 
- Access exclusive in-store coupons and promo codes that you can redeem just by snapping a picture of your receipt.
-Play games on your phone. 
-Discover new products and services. Get paid for installing free new apps, signing up for eNewsletters, trying free samples, and more. 
- Earn cash back when you shop online at your favorite merchants like Walmart, Kohl's, Macy's, Booking.com, Lowes, Best Buy, and over 1,000 more. Earn 1% to 40% cash back on purchases at popular partner stores. Cash back amounts will vary merchant by merchant. Visit individual merchant store pages to see full details. And you can explore all the last promotions and deals, including coupon codes for your favorite brands and BOGO alerts. 
Disclaimer: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00131344:ios.description:
Instantly compare your travel options in real-time across all transport modes globally! 
Easily navigate your city with turn-by-turn directions for all your public transportation, walking, cycling and scooter trips.
THOUSANDS OF 5 STAR REVIEWS
* "This is my favorite transit app. Full-featured and a breeze to use. I really appreciate the Uber integration."
* "Only way to get around NYC and Chicago. Easy and accurate. Download this one NOW"
* "I love it. It’s the best thing since zippers, peanut and jelly and 1 TB thumb drives"
* "Support for the SF Bay Area is particularly impressive because it aggregates all transit systems imaginable (BART, Caltrain, MUNI, VTA, etc.) into one seamless app"
FIND THE BEST ROUTE ► Simple trip planning combining all transport modes: bus, subway, train, ferry, cabs, ride share, car share, bike share, e-scooters and walking. Discover routes you never knew existed
HIT THE GO BUTTON FOR STEP-BY-STEP DIRECTIONS ► Turn-by-turn navigation for all your transit, walking, personal cycling, bike shares and scooter trips. Choose between 3 different map views, see the charge levels of e-scooters and e-bikes around you, we even help you avoid no-parking zones. We take care of the logistical thinking so you are free to enjoy the ride
EXPERIENCE ONE-STOP-SHOP MOBILITY ► Compare cab fares, hail a ride, hop on a shared bike or find the nearest e-scooter all from within the app. Our partners include: Uber, Lyft, JUMP, Lime, Bird, Spin, Skip, Scoot, Citi Bike, JerseryBike, Bluebikes, Indego, CaBi, Divvy, Metro Bike, Breeze, Bay Wheels, Healthy Ride, Relay, BCycle, SA Bike Share, GREENbike, Grid, RTC Bike, BIKETOWN, Biki 
BEAT THE RUSH HOUR CROWD ► Live wait times and ETA so you'll never miss a bus, train or ferry again. Follow your bus / train as it's approaching on a real-time map, see the best train car to board, get alerted when it's time to get off, and get in and out from the best exit at any subway / train station 
PERSONALIZE YOUR CITY ► Save Home, Work and your go-to stops or stations for lightning fast trip planning. Subscribe to your favorite subway, train, bus or ferry line for automatic disruption, delay, and status alerts
GET SOCIAL ► Share your live trip: let friends follow your live trip to know when you'll arrive. Share any location or address: one tap for others to get directions
TRAVEL OFFLINE ► Access offline the official NYC subway map, Manhattan bus map, Brooklyn bus map, Queens bus map, DC metro map, Muni Metro map, and more

bluejetty:00145154:ios.description:
Flickplay is the destination to unlock your favorite digital avatars, explore self-expression, and discover mini-games & communities to join. Flickplay redefines social storytelling with digital avatars, empowering people to let their authenticity and creativity shine.
- Digital Avatars in the Real World
Using Flickplay’s Augmented Reality (AR) camera, users can watch, play, and record unforgettable memories with their favorite virtual avatars in the real world. Experience the magic of AR video, augmented reality, and AR video features as you bring your digital collectibles to life.
- Unlocking Digital Avatars
Users can purchase digital avatars in various ways. They can get a free digital avatar upon downloading the app. Additionally, users can purchase virtual Mystery Boxes, which contain surprise avatars. New collections of avatars will be added to the marketplace soon. From 3D avatars to decentralized digital assets and NFTs, explore the extensive range of collectibles.
- Create and Share Content
Flickplay’s video creation tools allow users to record their favourite moments with their digital avatars and edit the clip to get their stories just right! Users can import their favorite audios or access free music through the Flickplay library. Once their fun stories are ready to go, users can download or share their videos on Flickplay’s feed, connecting with community members through creativity and self-expression. Use special effects, reality composer, and camera simulator to enhance your videos.
- Community and Social Interaction
Flickplay fosters a sense of community among its users. It offers social challenges that users can participate in, encouraging engagement and friendly competition. Live messaging chat facilitates communication between users, making it easy for like-minded members to connect and stay in touch. Join the vibrant community and make friends with fellow collectors and creators. Safely engage with others in a secure environment.
- Play and Level Up
On Flickplay, users will discover mini-games featuring the digital avatars. As users play, they will earn experience points (XP) that contribute towards their level on Flickplay. The higher their user level is, the more access they get to exclusive perks and accessories to personalise their virtual avatars. bluejetty:00015144:ios.description:
Cupixel is a tracing app that helps anyone learn to make real art -
trace thousands of free designs onto paper, canvas, shoes, cookies,
cards, and more, or turn your own photos into personalized art with
a Cupixel membership.
No drawing experience needed. Cupixel is great for beginners, kids,
and family craft time. Choose a photo or a design from our library,
and Cupixel turns it into a traceable outline. Place your phone above
the surface you want to personalize, trace what you see, then add
color and detail by hand.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a photo, template, or class
2. Cupixel turns it into a traceable outline
3. Place your phone above paper, canvas, or any surface
4. Trace what Cupixel shows you
5. Add your own color, detail, and style
LEARN AS YOU CREATE
Learn from hundreds of recorded, artist-led classes covering drawing,
sketching, watercolor, and acrylic painting - no experience needed.
Watch on your own schedule with step-by-step video lessons, or trace
independently using our free design library.
WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
- Personalized photo art and pet portraits
- Handmade gifts, cards, and home decor
- Custom shoes, bags, and accessories
- Sketches, watercolor paintings, and acrylic art
- Comics, journaling pages, and hand-lettering
BUILT FOR REAL CRAFT PROJECTS
Cupixel works on canvas, paper, wood, shoes, cookies, cards, and
almost any surface. Record a timelapse of your process, share your
art with the Cupixel community, and shop optional physical art kits
to match your project.
Cupixel is for anyone who has ever said, “I wish I could draw that.”

bluejetty:00148693:ios.summary: Explore inspirational stories for kids from the award-winning podcast “Good Night Stories for Rebel Girls” to wind down for bedtime, learn about amazing real-life women, and broaden horizons. Rebel Girls is completely free and KidSafe––no a
bluejetty:00148693:ios.description:
Explore inspirational stories for kids from the award-winning podcast “Good Night Stories for Rebel Girls” to wind down for bedtime, learn about amazing real-life women, and broaden horizons. Rebel Girls is completely free and KidSafe––no ads or subscriptions. Rebel Girls immerses kids and grownups alike into audio stories about the adventures and accomplishments of women from around the world and throughout history, including incredible women who are active today. 
** 2023 App Store Award finalist for Cultural Impact ** — Apple
** 2022 Apple Design Award winner for Social Impact ** — Apple
Rebel Girls is the best app for kids who want to discover new heroes, or learn more about dazzling women like Frida Kahlo, Simone Biles, Kamala Harris, Ada Lovelace, Oprah Winfrey, and more. Girls will learn about hundreds of inspiring women from all around the world from hundreds of stories, including activities, soundscapes, and biographical stories of famous historical women figures. Girls will build confidence while listening to a rich audio library of and delight in original illustrations drawn by female and non-binary international artists. Each story is 10-20 minutes, so they’re perfect for getting to sleep, listening during a commute, or anytime.
Rebel Girls Features:
- Ever-growing library of free audio stories: 10-20 min episodes highlight powerful female figures
- Motivational stories: Inspiring tales that allow listeners to imagine the real-life experience of Rebel women
- Curated playlists: stories for kids based on diverse women with different professions, passions, countries, and qualities, like perseverance, motivation, leadership, creativity, and courage
- Sleep stories: Memorable bedtime stories told from the worlds of different inspiring women
- Soundscapes: Relaxing soundscapes situated in the worlds of Rebel women including the jungles of Kenya and the waves of the Pacific Ocean
- Daily polls and trivia to spark curiosity and conversation
- Moments of gratitude and affirmations
- Screen-limited and screen-free content
- Guided activities for girls to explore their creativity, learn emotional intelligence, and draw along with imaginative stories
- Download stories for offline listening on the go.
**The app and audio experience for girls of all ages:**

Ever wonder what represents the total amount of all your bills between two salaries? 
As a Bill Tracker, BillOut will give you this information.
Got any friends, family members or flatmates whom you share any bills with?
Create a shared bill, assign different amounts if you need and receive all a notification on the due date.
BillOut can help you:
- Budget your money more effectively by allowing you to plan for upcoming bills.
- Reduce stress and anxiety by staying on top of your finances.
- Set customized reminders to make sure you never miss a payment again.
 --- A bundle of personalised features ---

Get great insights about all your bills between salaries by tracking your incomes and expenses. BillOut is the perfect financial advisor.

Choose when you want to receive your notifications. Up to 3 days in advance.
Multiple Frequencies
One-Off, Daily, weekly, every 2 weeks, monthly, quarterly, biannual, annually, BillOut got you covered.

Weekly Report
Receive a summary of your upcoming bills every first day of the week.

See all your upcoming bills in a beautiful calendar view to plan and organize your financial life ahead
Dark Mode
Choose between Light and Dark theme.

No email or name required to sign-up. Just one click and you are good to go.

bluejetty:00183370:ios.description:
Fasting Time puts the power of the intermittent fasting diet into your hands. Lose weight, improve your health and reach your goals and stay on track with your fasts.
Features
- Elegant intermittent fasting tracker with over 10 different display modes
- Works with any fasting schedule or diet
- Always stay up to date with Fasting Time's notification service
- Progress at a glance: easily see your personal before and after story
- Review and edit your fasting history
- Track how you lose weight with photos and notes
- Set up and track as many fasts as you want! Combine intermittent fasting with other fast methods like OMAD
- Compare your recent fasts with charts and timelines
- Customizable goal and a reminder when you reach it
- Daily motivational message
- Share your progress with your fasting community
- Fully customizable with unique backgrounds, icons and themes to match your diet
- Password protected

- Keep track of your progress by setting up a daily goal for the timer
- Complete weigh ins to track and manage your weight loss and health
- Add notes and photos to every step of your health journey
- Stay motivated with daily inspirational messages to power your fast

- Summarize the time you have been fasting down to the second
- Use the progress on your fasting clock to motivate you when things get difficult

- Let Fasting Time run its countdown timer in the notification bar to keep you updated throughout your fast day
- Set up an individual countdown timer widget for each of your active fasts
- Quickly access your entire fasting history, with the ability to add, edit or delete entries
- Receive a notification when your intermittent fasting tracker is complete
Weight loss, your way.
- Completely customizable countdown timer that works with any fasting program
- Perfect for intermittent fasting, water fasts, one meal a day or your own custom schedule
- Easily integrate the eating schedule of your diet
- Fully customizable fasting tracker and widget
- Customize each fast with a different intermittent fasting tracker, backgrounds, icons and headings
- Couple it with your healthy diet for excellent results

- Track each of your fasts separately
- Set up an unique fast for each fasting method you want to do, be it water fasting, intermittent fasting or OMAD 
- Weigh Ins let you add your own photos and notes, letting you easily see the progress you've made
- Review your recent activity in a beautiful design
With Fasting Time you can track your fasts and stay motivated wherever you are. Set up an intermittent fasting tracker, commit to a long-term fast or try eating one meal a day. It has multiple display options, a powerful fasting clock and counters, customizable goals.
Get Fasting Time now to manage your fasts, lose weight and reach your goals!

bluejetty:00062355:ios.description:

bluejetty:00138518:ios.description:
Do you want to boost your math skills? Math Flashcards is a great practice tool designed for people of all ages and proficiency levels. 
With user-friendly tips, comprehensive practice sets, and different game modes, you'll unleash your arithmetic potential in no time. The app offers different levels to keep you engaged as you progress.
The app supports all four of the major arithmetic operations - as well as a mixed operations mode that randomly shows all types of problems:
- Addition
- Subtraction
- Multiplication
- Division
There are three different modes to make math problem solving more interesting:
- Choice: choose the correct answer
- Enter: type the results of your mental calculations
- Flash Cards: review what you've learned 
From addition and subtraction to multiplication, division, and a mixed operations mode, we've got your arithmetic needs covered. Get ready to improve your math skills and conquer each new challenge with confidence!
You can start counting right away — one level, one mode, and 4 math operations are free to try! Want more? Unlock the full experience anytime with a subscription.

bluejetty:00024844:ios.description:
• iCloud Synchronization between iOS and MacOS X! 
• Checklist style notes! Manage your tasks directly on notes.
abcNotes was designed to become your stylish and highly customizable, functional and easy to use assistant in taking notes and managing To Do lists. abcNotes is an awesome note taking application! It takes advantage of unique iOS devices touchscreen preserving realistic look & feel of paper sticky notes. 
abc Notes - Checklist & Sticky Note Application for iPhone and iPad (share, email and synch your lists, memos, projects and school notebooks)
HINT: To make a checklist note: Double tap the note to edit it. Tap the Note Properties button (blue one with tools icon). Find the checklist switch next to text alignment toggles. The total number of unchecked items is displayed as badge on abcNotes icon.
BEAUTIFUL APPEARANCE:
• 88 backgrounds to choose from
• 45 note skins 
• 27 badge designs & 115 icons
EXTREMELY FUNCTIONAL: 
• 15 virtual desktops
• Scale, rotate and drag notes
• Easy to edit, duplicate, move between desktops
• Supports any iPad orientation
SHARE YOUR NOTES:
• Email notes and desktops
• Copy note image to any application 
• Synchronize notes between iOS devices
• Save notes as image and place to lock or home screen
No more boring note lists – abcNotes brings you the ability to make REAL notes on your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch. Put everything you need to remember into abcNotes! View you notes the way you want! Rotate your abcNotes to any angle you wish! 
abcNotes is great for shopping lists, student class notebook, to record lecture and interview notes or to track projects, recordings and more tasks at home, school and university (class or homework). 
Please feel free to contact us at alsedi.apple@gmail.com if you have suggestions, feature requests, or bug reports.

bluejetty:00174450:ios.summary:
Mapway - Public Transport Maps - Plan City Travel With Confidence
Mapway is your public transport companion for navigating busy cities around the world. Built for tourists, travellers, and daily commuters, Mapway helps you explore metro, s
bluejetty:00174450:ios.description:
Mapway - Public Transport Maps - Plan City Travel With Confidence
Mapway is your public transport companion for navigating busy cities around the world. Built for tourists, travellers, and daily commuters, Mapway helps you explore metro, subway, tram, rail, and bus networks with clear maps, simple route planning, and useful travel information in one easy app.
City Coverage
Mapway supports public transport systems in cities including London, New York, Paris, Tokyo, Singapore, Hong Kong, Berlin, Madrid, Rome, Dubai, Seoul, Shanghai, Toronto, Washington DC, Barcelona, Milan, Munich, Chicago, Boston, Delhi, Mexico City, Stockholm, Manchester, and more.
Interactive Transit Maps
Mapway includes redesigned schematic maps built for mobile devices. Zoom, move around the map, check station details, and follow routes clearly. The maps are designed to make city navigation simple, whether you are above ground, underground, or travelling abroad.
Key Features
• Interactive metro, subway, tram, rail, and bus maps
• Simple journey planning with step-by-step guidance
• Offline route planning between stations
• Live departure boards in select cities
• Real-time station status and transit updates where available
• Crowdsourced station busyness information
• Favourite stations for quick access
• Live over-the-air map updates
• City travel guides with tips and recommendations
• Fare information to help plan your journey budget
• First and last train information for subscribers
• Free ad-supported access with optional premium upgrade
Simple Journey Planning
Plan routes quickly with clear directions and easy-to-follow journey steps. Mapway helps you compare transit options, understand connections, and move around the city without confusion. Offline route planning is useful when you have no signal, are travelling underground, or want to avoid roaming issues abroad.
Live Travel Information
For supported cities, Mapway provides live departure boards, station updates, and transit alerts. Crowdsourced station busyness can help you make better travel decisions by showing useful information from other commuters and travellers.
Built For Commuters And Travellers
Save your favourite stations for faster access, check maps before leaving, and keep important transport details close at hand. Mapway is designed for everyday travel, weekend city breaks, business trips, and international journeys.
Premium Access
Upgrade to premium to remove ads and unlock additional travel tools, including first and last train information. Some features may vary by city depending on local transit data availability.
Start Your Journey
Use Mapway to plan routes, check maps, view departures, save favourite stations, and travel with a clearer understanding of the city around you.
Privacy Policy: https://mapway.ai/mapwaymapsios/privacy/
Terms and Conditions: https://mapway.ai/mapwaymapsios/terms/

Mapway supports public transport systems in cities including London, New York, Paris, Tokyo, Singapore, Hong Kong, Berlin, Madrid, Rome, Dubai, Seoul, Shanghai, Toronto, Washington DC, Barcelona, Milan, Munich, Chicago, Boston, Delhi, Mexico City, Stockholm, Manchester, and more.

Interactive Transit Maps
Mapway includes redesigned schematic maps built for mobile devices. Zoom, move around the map, check station details, and follow routes clearly. The maps are designed to make city navigation simple, whether you are above ground, underground, or travelling abroad.

Key Features
• Interactive metro, subway, tram, rail, and bus maps
• Simple journey planning with step-by-step guidance
• Offline route planning between stations
• Live departure boards in select cities
• Real-time station status and transit updates where available
• Crowdsourced station busyness information
• Favourite stations for quick access
• Live over-the-air map updates
• City travel guides with tips and recommendations
• Fare information to help plan your journey budget
• First and last train information for subscribers
• Free ad-supported access with optional premium upgrade

Simple Journey Planning
Plan routes quickly with clear directions and easy-to-follow journey steps. Mapway helps you compare transit options, understand connections, and move around the city without confusion. Offline route planning is useful when you have no signal, are travelling underground, or want to avoid roaming issues abroad.

Live Travel Information
For supported cities, Mapway provides live departure boards, station updates, and transit alerts. Crowdsourced station busyness can help you make better travel decisions by showing useful information from other commuters and travellers.

Built For Commuters And Travellers
Save your favourite stations for faster access, check maps before leaving, and keep important transport details close at hand. Mapway is designed for everyday travel, weekend city breaks, business trips, and international journeys.

Premium Access
Upgrade to premium to remove ads and unlock additional travel tools, including first and last train information. Some features may vary by city depending on local transit data availability.

Start Your Journey
Use Mapway to plan routes, check maps, view departures, save favourite stations, and travel with a clearer understanding of the city around you.

bluejetty:00131269:ios.summary:
Challenge your friends to an online multiplayer categories word game!!!

STOP, Tutti Frutti, Bus STOP or Basta - whatever you may call it, th
bluejetty:00131269:ios.description:
Challenge your friends to an online multiplayer categories word game!!!
STOP 2 is the pen-and-paper trivia word game you know and love ... and now it's better than ever!
STOP, Tutti Frutti, Bus STOP or Basta - whatever you may call it, the goal of this words game is still the same - to answer the word categories with the correct terms, beat competitors, and have lots of fun. Can you guess the answer? How smart are you?
One letter! Five-word categories! 60 seconds! Infinite chances to become a trivia quiz legend of challenge games... or at least laugh, have fun and play with your friends. It's fresher, funnier, and more hectic than ever—and yet, no pen or paper required.
STOP 2 has updated the beloved quiz word game STOP for the modern concept of online games with friends. A new, customized experience where you can collect timers and select skins. There are themed, unique events, advanced multiplayer games and match-making, and new word game modes to play this challenging quiz.
From the studio that brought you the smash-hit crossword categories game CodyCross, Word Lanes, Everyday Puzzle: Fun Brain Games, LunaCross: Crossword Riddles, and the award-winning original game STOP - Guess the answer, an App Store Editor's Choice in 18 countries!
UNIQUE AND CLASSIC FEATURES
- An update of the pen-and-paper categories word trivia game!
- One on one...don’t forget to invite others and enjoy this online game with friends, also known as tutti frutti
- Done answering? Stop the timer and end your rival’s answer round early. Word with friends is even better now. A trivia word game where you guess correctly or lose
- 200+ fun and unique categories (and counting)! Can you answer more them 20 questions and categories in a row?
- Play anywhere: on the couch, on the go, on your lunch break ... it's all good! The perfect, fun games for when you're bored
- Friends busy? Don't let the game STOP. Let the multiplayer matchmaking feature find you a brand new nemesis to add to your fight list
- Learn new words, answer questions, meet new people, and become a STOP champion and master.
NEW FEATURES
How many trivia games do you know of that are this fun? Are you ready to enjoy the new features of this riddle challenge and multiplayer game?
- Hone your skills against tricky AI opponents in the new arcade gameplay mode of this word categories game!
- Create a CUSTOM look all your own with new themed skins. Play with friends and see who has the best skin.
- Collect new themed timers in this online game with friends!
- New seasonal, themed, and timed events offer fresh challenges. Guess the answer and show off your word skills!
- Player rankings to display your word puzzle prowess and trivia crack skills to the world!
STOP 2 is a word, trivia, and general knowledge competitive and category game. Can you guess the answers? The prizes are waiting for you!
NON-STOP WORD GAME
Are you a competitive player? Do you like word games more than others? You can take advantage of available boosts - unlimited life power-up and no ads ever! You can have no ads game. These power-ups are for those who are passionate about trivia word games and want to develop their word category knowledge.
CATEGORIES GAME AND FUN CHALLENGE
Can you guess the answer to all the riddles? There are categories for everyone, from "circular objects" to "dog's common names". What about challenges? Are you a master of trivia? Test your skills and see how fast can you answer all five categories.
STOP 2 is a unique, new experience made from player to player. We want you to enjoy this fun with your friends, family, and the world. Here, you can build a community of friends who want to learn, challenge and meet new people.
You can read our privacy policy at https://fanatee.com/privacy-policy
You can read our terms of use at https://fanatee.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00037178:ios.description:
Glovo is the #1 app for ordering anything you want! With more than 240,000 restaurants & stores available, and delivery in minutes. Download the app now & order a Glovo!
Easily order food, groceries and gifts in your city without leaving home.
Want to order food straight to your door? Or get a grocery delivery of your essentials? We save you time, when you don’t have it. 
WHY USE GLOVO?
▶ Over 80 million downloads worldwide.
▶ Order in 23 countries including Spain, Portugal, Romania, Morocco, Italy, Poland, Croatia, Ukraine, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tunisia, Kenya, Uganda, Ivory Coast, Nigeria, Bulgaria, Serbia, Armenia, Bosnia-herzegovina, Montenegro, Moldova & Andorra.
▶ More than 240,000 restaurants, supermarkets and stores available globally.
▶ Deliveries from the biggest chains: McDonald's, Burger King, KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell, Telepizza, Starbucks, Domino’s Pizza, Carrefour, PENNY., Eataly, Flying Tiger, Kiko Milano, Lafarmacia, Auchan, Decathlon, MediaMarkt and many more.
▶ Your favourite food delivery in minutes: Order burgers, pizza, chicken, kebab, pasta, sandwiches, sushi, poké…anything you want.
▶ Pay however you like. We accept PayPal, card payment, cash and even restaurant vouchers.
▶ Track your delivery or takeaway in real time and chat with our support team if need be.
▶ Subscribe to Glovo Prime and get unlimited free deliveries of food, groceries, and shopping. Save on every delivery! Available in selected countries.
▶ Invite your friends and earn money for each one who places an order on the app.
YOUR FAVOURITE FOOD, IN MINUTES!
Fancy a tasty dinner? Has it been a long day? You deserve to have your food delivered to your door! Or are you on your way somewhere? You can order food to take away and grab it on the go.
With Glovo, you can order up to 65 different types of food in your city. Including a burger from the most famous restaurants, to ordering from your favourite sushi place. There are more than 216,000 restaurants available worldwide for delivery or takeaway of your favourite food, in a matter of minutes.
GROCERY DELIVERY WITHOUT LEAVING HOME
Forget something from the supermarket? Got friends over and want to order another round of drinks or snacks? 
Now you can also order your groceries from the supermarket. Choose whatever you want from your favourite supermarket or local store and Glovo will deliver it to you in a few minutes. Food, snacks, drinks, something sweet, a missing ingredient... any groceries you need! 
THE APP TO ORDER ANYTHING
Glovo delivers everything. Find more than 27000 stores on the app, with all kinds of products. All your shopping on one app: surprise gifts, a last-minute purchase or whatever you need.
And if you need to send or pick up something in your city, Glovo can run errands for you. Choose a pick-up and delivery point and a courier will take care of the rest, with delivery in minutes!
NEED HELP? CONTACT US
If you’re looking for help with an order or have any questions about Glovo, please contact our support team via the support section in our app or on our website.
You can also find us on:
▶ Our site: https://glovoapp.com/ 
▶ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/glovoappES 
▶ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/glovo_es/ 
▶ Twitter: https://twitter.com/Glovo_ES
Download Glovo now! Order food, groceries, shopping or courier service - with delivery in minutes.

bluejetty:00073995:ios.description:
Welcome to Coco Valley!
Discover a Magical Land
Experience the magic of Coco Valley, a world full of adventure and wonder. Travel through a mystical portal to visit a variety of enchanting islands, each with its own unique environment to discover. From lush forests to sandy beaches, you'll never know what wonders you'll find as you journey from island to island in this fantastical land. Whether you're seeking treasure, solving puzzles, or simply soaking up the beauty of each island, there's always something new to explore in Coco Valley.
Build and Design
You have the power to shape your own island paradise. With over 20 crafting workshops to build and more than 40 lovely decorations to collect, you can create a unique and personalized home that reflects your style and personality. Let your imagination run wild as you build and decorate to your heart's content. Start building and decorating in Coco Valley today and make your dream home a reality!
Craft and Farm
You can craft and farm to your heart's content. With a wide range of crafting workshops and crops to choose from, the possibilities for creation and cultivation are endless. Over 100 items are waiting to be crafted and collected, giving you the chance to customize your farm and home to your liking. Build your own farm and start growing a variety of crops, from juicy fruits to savory herbs. Then, take your harvest to the crafting workshop and see what unique items and equipment you can create. 
Harvest and Cook
Experience the joy of cooking in Coco Valley, where you can harvest and collect a variety of crops and ingredients to create delicious cuisines. From fresh produce to rare spices, the possibilities for culinary exploration are endless. Build your own kitchen and start cooking up a storm today! Whether you're a seasoned chef or just starting out, Coco Valley has something for everyone. With a wide range of ingredients to choose from and the freedom to create whatever dishes you can imagine, the fun of cooking in Coco Valley knows no bounds.
Live-Events and Quests
There's always something new and exciting happening! There are live events throughout the year to keep you entertained. During the Halloween event, you can explore the spooky Vampire Castle and uncover its secrets. The castle is filled with hidden chambers, mysterious artifacts, and maybe even a few ghosts. As you make your way through the castle, you'll have to solve puzzles and overcome challenges to progress. It's a thrilling adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Or, join in the Fall Camping event and cook up a delicious turkey. Whether you're grilling, baking, or frying, there are plenty of tasty recipes to try. And when Easter rolls around, hop over to Bunny King Island to make your own bunny hat and celebrate the season.

* Max engery +20

This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

bluejetty:00179777:ios.description:

With this app, users can watch and listen to LIVE Dhamma talks by Thitsarparami Sayadaw every Sunday, based on Singapore Time. Additionally, we have curated a collection of renowned Sayadaws' Dhamma mp3s, including Dr. Ashin Nandamalabhivamsa, Sitagu Sayadaw, Pilot Sayadaw, and many more.
The Thitsarparami app is completely free of charge, and we are grateful for all the support we receive. Download the app now and immerse yourself in the teachings of Dhamma through a wide range of mp3s. Enjoy the spiritual journey with us!

With 150,0
bluejetty:00177188:ios.description:
Play one of the most exciting word puzzle and typing games with multiple game modes in a single app. Word Connect 2026 helps improve typing speed, vocabulary, spelling, and brain skills while providing fun and relaxing gameplay.
With 150,000+ words and multiple word puzzle modes, this game is perfect for players who enjoy word search, crossword, typing games, and brain training puzzles.
Challenge yourself with different word challenges and discover new words while playing.
Multiple Word Game Modes
====================
Enjoy a collection of popular word puzzle games in one app:
• Typing Master
• Word/Text Battle
• Word Connect
• Word Cross / Crossword Puzzle
• Word Search Puzzle
• Word Scrolling
• Word Pair Mini Game
• Word Pearls
Each mode offers unique gameplay designed to improve your typing skills and vocabulary knowledge.
Typing Master Mode
===============
Type the words that fall from the top of the screen before they reach the bottom. Missing too many words will reduce your lives.
Use special lifelines to help you survive longer:
• Tornado – Clears all words on the screen
• Bomb – Destroys all words instantly
• Heart – Restores your lives
• Frozen – Freezes the screen temporarily
Improve your typing speed, reaction time, and accuracy while chasing high scores.
Word Connect
===========
Relax and solve thousands of word puzzles by connecting letters to create hidden words.
• More than 1800 unique levels
• 152 chapters with multiple puzzles
• Discover bonus words for extra rewards
• Use hints if you get stuck
• Swipe letters to form words
Perfect for fans of word connect and word search games.
Word Cross / Crossword
==================
Solve crossword puzzles by finding correct words from the given letters.
• More than 100 levels
• Each level contains 5–8 words
• Swipe or tap letters to form words
• Use hints to solve difficult puzzles
Word Search
==========
Find hidden words across different categories.
Categories include:
Animals
Fruits & Vegetables
Countries & Cities
Plants & Flowers
Fish
Astronomy
Rivers & Mountains
Cars and more.
Word Scrolling
===========
Identify the correct word from a rolling letter board before time runs out.
Includes many categories such as:
Animals
Body Parts
Flowers
Cooking
Cities
Countries
Colors
Games & Sports
Computers
Art and more.
Word Pearls
=========
A combination of multiple word puzzle styles.
• More than 500 levels
• Four different themes
• Real-time visual effects
Word Pair
=======
Find the correct pair from given options.
Examples include:
• Opposite words
• Compound words
• Related word pairs
Includes 1000+ word pairs.
Game Features
============
• 150,000+ English words
• Multiple word puzzle modes
• Improve typing speed and accuracy
• Boost vocabulary and spelling skills
• Smooth gameplay and simple controls
• Beautiful graphics and animations
• Suitable for kids and adults
Train Your Brain
============
Word Connect 2026 helps you develop important skills:
• Faster typing speed
• Better vocabulary
• Improved spelling
• Stronger brain training
• Better focus and memory
Download Word Connect 2026 – Word Find and enjoy a fun combination of typing games, word puzzles, and brain training challenges.

在“柠檬公寓”足不出户“即可挑选琳琅满目的商品！轻食全餐、减脂零食、运动器械应有尽有，实现快乐减脂就从选购开始吧~

【DIY家居装扮】
除了那些有的没的，还可以装扮你的家~春夏假日风，唯美复古风，完成每日任务就可以获取漂亮的家具，来装扮你的可爱小家，让你努力的日子不再孤单。

胖友星人的秘密基地，在这里你可以邀请胖友伙伴们和你一起打卡互动，分享记录轻断食日常，还可以及时提醒胖友伙伴当前的体重、饮水、断食进度。
柠檬专属贴贴功能上线，把胖友们的温馨提醒贴在桌面上吧，时刻监督和记录，随时随地分享新状态！

你可以记录饮食、记录饮水量、记录体重、记录身体状态，一步一步见证你蜕变逆袭的过程！

敲黑板！！学会正确饮食，真的每天嘎嘎掉秤 ！

bluejetty:00070946:ios.description:
The amazing next-gen economic strategy game for true-born businessmen!
Have you ever dreamed of becoming a business tycoon? Big Business Deluxe gives you a chance to turn this dream into reality! Build a modern metropolis, set up your own business and make millions right now! Of course, there is a bumpy road ahead. It’s easy to start your business; the real challenge is to make it profitable and successful. On your way to the top you will build factories, manufacture your products and learn the secrets of effective management to keep all your enterprises under control.
Put your economic skills to work! Use different business tactics to be always one step ahead of your competitors and become the best entrepreneur possible. While reaching for fame and riches, do not forget to take care of your citizens. Expand your territory, develop infrastructure, extinguish fires and participate in public life.
Remember that your potential is limited by your ambition only! Start the game now: your boss chair is waiting for you!
Key features:
• This game works in offline mode without Internet – play it on the plane, in subway or on the road. Enjoy!
• Realistic atmosphere: life in the city goes on even when you are not in the game. Everything changes, just like in the real world. Your employees work and factories grow, making you wealthier with each passing hour.
• Competitive spirit: play together with your friends, participate in exciting contests and win unique prizes. Prove that you are the best and achieve success faster than your competitors!
• Manage your city: you hold the real power here. Your word is law! Take advantage of the endless possibilities the game offers you and build the ideal city!
• The game doesn’t require a permanent online connection: play anytime, anywhere you want.
Facebook Comunity: https://www.facebook.com/BBusinessGame 
Game Trailer: http://youtu.be/Uni-GfFKm-4

bluejetty:00129608:ios.description:

Once you starting playing this Ball Sort puzzle, you’ll want to show your friends and family how to match & stack colors too!
Ballscapes is the #1 ball sorting game. Whether you're winding down before bed or on a break, download now to start organizing now!

bluejetty:00188190:ios.name: Morning Light / Night Light
bluejetty:00188190:ios.summary:
Hazelden Publishing’s Morning Light / Night Light app combines two popular meditation books into one app for double the support for people in recovery from addiction.
Each day you will find two inspirational readings: one to start your day
bluejetty:00188190:ios.description:
Hazelden Publishing’s Morning Light / Night Light app combines two popular meditation books into one app for double the support for people in recovery from addiction.
Each day you will find two inspirational readings: one to start your day on a bright and positive note, and one to help calm and center you at the end of your day. A total of 732 readings (2 for each day of the year) are included. No subscriptions or in-app purchases are required.
Each reading focuses on a specific topic and ends with a simple prayer or affirmation. Topics include: self-esteem, relationships, independence, fear, health, making mistakes, gratitude, and many others. Author Amy E. Dean gently reminds us of all the tools we have access to: the Twelve Steps, sponsors, slogans, our Higher Power, prayer, and meditation. Also included are handy reference lists of the Twelve Steps and the Twelve Traditions of AA.
When the app is opened each day, it will automatically show you that day’s reading. Choose a time for a daily notification reminding you to read, reflect, and meditate on that day’s reading and on your recovery. Open the app anytime you need to refocus on your sobriety.
About the Author
Amy E. Dean is the best-selling author of several meditation books, and is an in-demand speaker on recovery topics and self-esteem.
Features:
PRESS the “Today” button to access today’s reading.
SWIPE forward or back to easily access more daily readings.
SWITCH between morning and night meditations, favorites, and search results using the sun/moon icon.
SHARE the daily reading with friends by e-mail or text.
BOOKMARK your favorite meditations (press the star in the upper right-hand corner) and easily return to them (press the star in the bottom toolbar).
SEARCH for relevant keywords in both morning and night meditations.
RECEIVE a notification every day to remind you to read today’s messages.
JUMP to a specific reading using the calendar button.
SET your font size using your device settings.
CHOOSE between light or dark mode.

bluejetty:00200059:ios.name: Antizuck Smart Glasses Scanner
bluejetty:00200059:ios.summary:
Scan locally for nearby smart-glasses Bluetooth signals and get a clear alert when a likely device is close.
AntiZuck uses your device to show active signals that may come from smart glasses, including Ray-Ban Meta, Snap Spectacles, Amazon
bluejetty:00200059:ios.description:
Scan locally for nearby smart-glasses Bluetooth signals and get a clear alert when a likely device is close.
AntiZuck uses your device to show active signals that may come from smart glasses, including Ray-Ban Meta, Snap Spectacles, Amazon Echo Frames, and RayNeo. It also shows repeat sightings, confidence, and rough proximity.
FEATURES
• Live signal field: likely glasses appear as blips with rough proximity and confidence
• Local alerts when a likely device starts broadcasting. With Pro, alerts keep coming even when the app is closed, when iOS permits background scanning
• Sightings history: repeat encounters, confidence, distance, and why each signal was flagged
• Add familiar glasses to Your Circle with custom labels, optional relationships, and per-device alert controls
• Show rough proximity in feet or meters
• Snooze alerts for an hour or the evening, right from the notification (Pro)
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with the latest status and a pause button
• Control Center toggle to pause or resume scanning, assignable to the Action Button
• Spot Camera Glasses: a visual guide to camera placement, indicator lights, and frame shapes on common models (Pro)
FREE AND PRO
AntiZuck is free to download. Free includes:
• Live scanning and alerts while the app is open
• Sightings from the last 24 hours
• One entry in Your Circle
• Widgets and the Control Center toggle
AntiZuck Pro adds:
• Alerts with the app closed
• Snooze from the notification
• Full sightings history
• Unlimited Your Circle
• The Spot Camera Glasses visual guide
Pay once or subscribe, your call. Pro Lifetime is $9.99, paid once. Pro Annual is $8.99 per year and starts with a 7-day free trial. Pro Monthly is $2.99 per month. Prices are in US dollars and vary by country. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings. Bought AntiZuck before it was free? You already have Pro Lifetime.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://blue-twig.com/privacy/
Privacy stays local. The app does not identify people, record audio or video, track location, or upload signal history. Detection is best-effort and depends on what nearby devices advertise over Bluetooth. Smart glasses mostly broadcast at power-on, pairing, and case-open, so coverage is opportunistic.
No account, no ads, no analytics. Bluetooth history and nearby camera matching stay on your phone.
Pro includes a Flock camera map using a saved public list, with nearby, city/address and map-area search. Medium widgets can optionally show your last nearby check. Location is used for foreground nearby checks; matching stays on device. Apple provides map tiles and place searches and may receive the visible area or search query. This is not a live camera detector.

Covered by WIRED, Forbes, The Wall Street Journa
bluejetty:00073899:ios.description:
Used by Kendall Jenner, Snoop Dogg, BTS, Ariana Grande, Khloe Kardashian, Wiz Khalifa, Victoria Beckham, Die Antwoord and featured on SNL (S41E01) and in countless TV shows and music videos!
Covered by WIRED, Forbes, The Wall Street Journal, Popular Mechanics, The Independent, Macworld, TMZ, TechCrunch, Mashable and many others!
App of the Day for Friday, Dec 22, 2017
It's 1984, and you've got a VHS camcorder! It'll look that way when you record and send old, messed up-looking retro videos to friends. They'll swear you built a time machine: "OMG, how'd you shoot that?"
With Rarevision VHS, you'll make videos that look and sound like real retro video tapes pulled out of storage after 30 years. You can change the on-screen date to trick your friends, create custom animated titles, glitch up the picture by shaking your device and use the fake zoom to emphasize those truly embarrassing moments!
"That's freakin' amazing!" -Everyone
Here's Why You Need It:
• Four words: Best. Throwback. Videos. Ever.
• Create VHS-style retro videos of your kids that look like the ones from your childhood
• The only VHS cam app you should ever consider to capture your 80s and 90s-themed parties
• Shoot your own "found footage" movie and become a big Hollywood director like those other guys
• Make your kids' incredibly boring school plays actually rad
• Impress the new girl by using our app to convince her you built a time machine
• Pretend like you lived through the rad 1980s using our app!
What Rarevision VHS Can Do:
• Realism: the ORIGINAL and BEST VHS cam app for simulating the glitches of old videotape recordings
• Import videos and give them the VHS look
• Make your own signature look using the old-school picture adjustment menu
• Create your own animated titles for the ultimate in on-screen awesomeness
• Change the on-screen date so people think you're way younger (or older) than you really are
• Glitch the picture during recording using your finger or by shaking your device
• Fake zoom feature dramatically enhances the cheese factor
• Don't think we forgot to make things sound retro terrible. We didn't.
• Up to 60p recording for a more accurate VHS video look (depends on device capability)
• Widescreen recording option (but would you REALLY want to use it?)
Follow Rarevision:
http://instagram.com/rarevision
http://x.com/rarevision
http://facebook.com/rarevisionvhs
Rarevision is a US-based company.

bluejetty:00019176:ios.description:
FEEL THE RUSH! KRITIKA: The White Knights
* Feel the adrenaline at your fingertips!
- Play the most exhilarating action RPG that will keep you electrified! 
- Intense EX skills that jump off the screen! Call upon a friend's Striker to help you dominate!
* Meet the champions!
- Rang: Unleash waves of her dual wielding attacks!
- Wandering Master: Utilizes beasts and talismans to turn the tide in his favor!
- Elemental Fairy: A magical girl weaving together spirits and four elements of magic for all-out attacks!
- Flame Striker: Overwhelms enemies with flaming attacks using her explosive gauntlet!
- Blade Dancer: Overwhelms enemies with swift and accurate slashes from her Phantom Sword!
- Lina: Illuminates both stages and battlefields with her flames and spear!
- Strike Archer: A deadly archer and her loyal falcon deals long-range & fatal damage!
- Steam Walker: Defeats enemies with splendid kicks!
- Halo Mage: Annihilates enemies with powerful artillery fire and magic!
- Monk: Uses his fists and powerful magic to smite evil!
- Mystic Wolf Guardian: Brilliant lightning skills! The power of Sirius! Enemies watch out, she'll destroy all those in her way! 
- Noblia: Dominates the enemies with different weapons and her super strong power!
- Ice Warlock: Powerful frost magic attack sweeps the enemies off the ground!
- Burst Breaker: Sprightly and unpredictable! Single strike will blast the entire battlefield!
- Eclair: Her second to none versatility will lead the enemies to their ruin!
- Blood Demon: Her bloodthirsty spear yearns for lives!
- Demon Blade: His blade cuts a bloody path through the battleground!
- Crimson Assassin: Cool as ice! The battlefield is her playground!
- Dark Valkyrie: She seduces with her chains and judges with her scythe!
- Berserker: Behold his rage as he destroys everything in sight!
- Cat Acrobat: Quick and agile, fall in love with her spunky fighting moves!
- Shadow Mage: His eerie shadow will ensnare and annihilate enemies!
* Experience a game system like no other!
- It's more fun if you work together! Enjoy the new Guild system!
- Pets that keep your side and make you stronger!
- Grow stronger through 115 different stages in Stage Mode!
- Encounter the Monster Wave! Attack an endless wave of monsters!
- Climb and conquer the 60 floors of the Tower of Tribulation!
- Test your skills in Arena, Versus, and Melee! Become the ultimate champion!
- Work together to defeat powerful bosses in "World Boss"!
- Use the Auto-Battle feature to clear stages more conveniently!
* Minimum Device Requirement: iPhone 4S
** This game is available in 한국어, English, 日本語, 中文简体, 中文繁體, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, Русский, Vietnam, ไทย
** There may be additional costs when trying to obtain certain items.

bluejetty:00122889:ios.description:
LendingTree's free personal finance app built to help you understand your credit, track rates, shop for loans, and make smarter financial decisions — all in one place.
YOUR FULL FINANCIAL PICTURE, AT A GLANCE 
See every account, every balance, and your total debt progress in a single view — no more jumping between apps. LendingTree tracks your debt over time so you can monitor your progress. 
KNOW YOUR CREDIT SCORE — AND WHAT'S BEHIND IT 
See your score, understand what's helping or hurting it, and get alerted the moment something changes. Credit health, demystified. 
TRACK RATES. MOVE AT THE RIGHT TIME. 
Set up rate tracking for the products you care about — mortgages, personal loans, home equity loans, and more — and get notified when the time is right to make a move. 
SHOP SMARTER FOR LOANS AND CARDS 
Save and compare personalized offers from the biggest lender network in the U.S. And when it's time to find a new card, CardIQ™ matches you to options you're likely to get approved for in about 30 seconds — no credit ding, no guesswork. 
STAY A STEP AHEAD OF FRAUD 
Instant credit monitoring alerts keep you in the loop whenever something changes on your credit file. 
LendingTree. When lenders compete, you win. 
Personal Loan Disclosure
Conditional personal loan offers through LendingTree’s marketplace are from third party providers of financial products and services from whom LendingTree may receive compensation. Conditional loan offers feature loan amounts of $1,000 to $50,000, rate quotes up to 35.99% APR, and repayment terms of 61 days to 180 months. Terms and conditions apply. All customers may not qualify. Rates and other loan terms are controlled by third parties, not LendingTree, and are subject to change without notice, including at the point of application. Depending on the lender, other fees may apply. You can view any particular offer’s terms and conditions for more information. All offers are conditional and subject to application with the lender and lender approval. 
Representative Repayment Example: A borrower receives a personal loan of $10,000 with a term of 36 months and an APR of 7.49% (which includes a 7.49% yearly interest rate and a $0 origination fee). They would receive $10,000 in their account and would have a required monthly payment of $311.02. Over the lifetime of their loan, their payments would total $11,196.59.
LendingTree, LLC is a Marketing Lead Generator and is a Duly Licensed Mortgage Broker, as required by law, with its main office located at 1415 Vantage Park Drive, Suite 700, Charlotte, NC 28203. NMLS ID #1136. License information available at https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/licenses-and-disclosures and https://nmlsconsumeraccess.org.

bluejetty:00021161:ios.description:
O aplicativo ifPonto Cell possibilita a marcação do ponto e controle da jornada de trabalho diretamente pelo celular.
Por favor, LEIA COM MUITA ATENÇÃO as informações a seguir:
– Recursos do novo ifPonto Cell –
• Marcação do ponto com foto e recurso de biometria facial;
• Controle da mobilidade de marcação do ponto com geolocalização e geodelimitação;
• Acesso direto do colaborador ao espelho de ponto atualizado;
• Registro do sentimento do colaborador no momento de marcação do ponto;
• Resumo das marcações realizadas que estão pendentes e sincronizadas;
• Comunicados do gestor e/ou administrador;
• Envio automático do comprovante da marcação do ponto por e-mail;
• Assinatura do espelho de ponto;
• Envio de justificativas;
• Holerite (recurso disponível mediante contratação avulsa);
• Informe de rendimentos (recurso disponível mediante contratação avulsa);
• Aprovações gerais (próximas atualizações).
– Utilização do aplicativo –
Para fazer uso deste aplicativo, é imprescindível que o usuário tenha obtido autorização antecipada do gestor ou do administrador do sistema ifPonto, por meio do departamento de Recursos Humanos da sua empresa.
Caso essa autorização não tenha sido concedida, o usuário não conseguirá efetuar o cadastro no aplicativo.
– Funcionalidades do aplicativo –
As funcionalidades do aplicativo podem ser disponibilizadas de acordo com as necessidades. Isso significa que o gestor ou a pessoa responsável pelo sistema ifPonto em cada empresa tem a flexibilidade de configurar e disponibilizar quais funcionalidades serão visíveis para cada grupo de colaboradores.
Se alguma funcionalidade essencial não estiver sendo exibida, será necessário entrar em contato com o gestor ou a pessoa responsável pelo sistema ifPonto no departamento de Recursos Humanos da sua empresa. Apenas eles poderão habilitar a correspondente funcionalidade no seu dispositivo, por meio do sistema ifPonto.
– Geolocalização –
Erros de geolocalização são derivados de falhas de conexão do próprio aparelho com a rede ou de configurações. Para ocorrer as marcações do ponto é necessário que os dados móveis estejam ligados junto da permissão do GPS.
– Fuso horário –
Os problemas com fuso horário no momento do registro do ponto podem estar relacionados às configurações do aparelho ou conexão com as redes disponíveis.
O ifPonto Cell sempre irá considerar, no registro do ponto, o horário oficial coletado nas redes disponíveis, ou seja, caso o aparelho não esteja configurado em modo automático, o registro do ponto não será realizado.
– Erros do aplicativo –
Muitos erros são resultantes da falta de atualizações, tanto do aplicativo quanto do sistema operacional iOS do próprio aparelho. Essas atualizações são importantes porque corrigem eventuais erros e aumentam a segurança dos dados. Mantenha o ifPonto Cell sempre atualizado, bem como o sistema operacional iOS do seu aparelho.
– Recuperação de senha –
O ifPonto Cell é um aplicativo integrado ao sistema ifPonto, com dados que transitam pela rede e são considerados sensíveis em termos de segurança da informação.
Diferentemente de aplicativos comuns ou que não tratam dados confidenciais, a gestão do acesso ao ifPonto Cell requer um protocolo de segurança que possa garantir a integridade dessas informações.
Por isso, a recuperação da senha é uma etapa que só pode ser realizada em dois casos:
1. Solicitação para redefinição senha via e-mail
O colaborador recebe o link para redefinir a senha no e-mail que estiver cadastrado no sistema ifPonto. Essa redefinição fica disponível apenas quando o usuário esqueceu a senha e errou em mais de 5 tentativas.
2. Solicitação para redefinição de senha via RH
O colaborador deve entrar em contato com o departamento de RH para que a senha seja redefinida.
Caso não haja um e-mail cadastrado no sistema ifPonto, o colaborador deverá solicitar a inclusão por meio do departamento de RH da empresa.

bluejetty:00093495:ios.description:
Discover Valley Wellness: Your Local NJ Cannabis Dispensary
Welcome to the official app of Valley Wellness, your trusted and community-focused cannabis dispensary in Raritan, New Jersey. This app brings the Valley Wellness experience to your fingertips, offering seamless access to our curated selection of premium cannabis products. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or exploring cannabis for the first time, the Valley Wellness app makes it easy to shop, learn, and connect with our expert team.
Why Choose Valley Wellness?
At Valley Wellness, we are committed to providing high-quality cannabis products in a welcoming and educational environment. Our mission is to enhance your well-being by offering products that suit your lifestyle. We believe cannabis can play a significant role in health and wellness, and our knowledgeable staff is dedicated to guiding you through your journey.
Key Features of the Valley Wellness App:
Browse Our Full Product Menu
Explore a wide range of cannabis products, including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, tinctures, topicals, and concentrates. Every product is thoroughly vetted to meet high standards, ensuring you receive only the best cannabis New Jersey has to offer.
Easy Online Ordering for Pickup
Skip the line with our simple online ordering system. Browse our extensive menu, place your order in a few taps, and pick it up at your convenience. We're here to make cannabis shopping quick and easy.
Personalized Product Recommendations
Not sure what you're looking for? The app provides tailored recommendations based on your preferences and past purchases, helping you find the perfect products for relaxation, pain relief, and more.
Stay Updated with Real-Time Notifications
Get real-time updates on product launches, promotions, and in-store events. You'll never miss out on exclusive deals or new arrivals at Valley Wellness, all tailored to our local community.
Loyalty Rewards Program
Earn points every time you shop, whether through the app or in-store. Redeem your points for discounts and special rewards. It's our way of thanking you for being part of the Valley Wellness community.
Exclusive In-App Offers
As an app user, you'll unlock access to exclusive offers and discounts on your favorite products. Enjoy special deals that you won't find anywhere else.
Dedicated Customer Support
Have questions? Easily reach out to our friendly and knowledgeable team through the app. Whether you need product recommendations or help with your order, we're here to assist you.
Community-Focused Cannabis
Valley Wellness isn't just a dispensary-it's a community hub. As a locally owned and operated business, we are committed to making cannabis more accessible and accepted throughout New Jersey. Our focus on education, wellness, and customer satisfaction sets us apart. Every cannabis journey is unique, and we're here to support you along the way.
Our dispensary is designed for comfort and accessibility, offering a clean and welcoming environment for all customers. Whether you visit us in-store or use our app, expect the same high level of care and service from our team.
Safety and Compliance
At Valley Wellness, safety is our top priority. All our products are rigorously tested to meet New Jersey's strict regulations, giving you peace of mind with every purchase. The app provides transparent product information, lab results, and clear dosage guidelines to ensure a safe and informed shopping experience.
Download the Valley Wellness App Today
Looking for relief, relaxation, or better sleep? The Valley Wellness app is your go-to resource for all things cannabis. Download today and join the growing community of New Jerseyans who trust Valley Wellness for their cannabis needs. With our app, discovering and purchasing cannabis products has never been easier-or more enjoyable.
Valley Wellness: Elevating Wellness, One Experience at a Time.

bluejetty:00090771:ios.summary:
Calibrate is the only weight loss program with published results demonstrating 18% average weight loss, sustained for two years: clinician-prescribed GLP-1, 1:1 video coaching, daily tracking, and a science-backed curriculum. 
The Calibrat
bluejetty:00090771:ios.description:
Calibrate is the only weight loss program with published results demonstrating 18% average weight loss, sustained for two years: clinician-prescribed GLP-1, 1:1 video coaching, daily tracking, and a science-backed curriculum. 
The Calibrate app is for members only. Visit joincalibrate.com to check your eligibility and sign up.
“Launched in 2020, Calibrate began offering GLP-1 drugs before they were popular. It offers biweekly health-coaching sessions it says help users improve eating, exercise, and sleep habits.” ––Wall Street Journal
Calibrate was created in partnership with leading minds in obesity treatment and metabolic health. Our comprehensive treatment plan is changing the way the world treats weight and driving lasting results for thousands of members:
- 18% average weight loss, sustained for two years
- 6” average reduction in waist circumference 
- 83% of members had reduced inflammation
- 9/10 members say Calibrate is the most effective program they’ve tried
The Calibrate app is your key to unlocking every part of your Metabolic Reset:
GET EXPERT CARE FROM YOUR MEDICAL TEAM
Complete a comprehensive health intake, order labs, attend a 30-minute video clinician visit, and get GLP-1 medication prescription updates—from the palm of your hand. 
STAY ACCOUNTABLE WITH 1:1 VIDEO COACHING
Together with your Accountability Coach, you’ll learn to make gradual lifestyle changes that will help reset your metabolic system and support lasting weight loss.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS TOWARD GOALS 
What you track becomes the data your Medical Team uses to adjust your medication and it’s what you and your coach use to refine and personalize your goals.
BUILD HABITS THROUGH A SCIENCE-BACKED CURRICULUM
Our proprietary curriculum is designed to help you establish new, sustainable habits across food, sleep, exercise, and emotional health—the Four Pillars of Metabolic Health, which are foundational to changing your physiology and achieving lasting weight loss.
Log into the app to:
TRACK 
- Track weight, energy level, red foods, steps, and sleep with streamlined daily trackers.
- Automate daily weight tracking with your Withings smart scale, and sync sleep and steps tracking to your device.
- Understand your progress over time and celebrate your wins throughout your Reset.
- Get ongoing accountability from your dedicated coach and care from the Medical Team based on your tracked metrics
LEARN
- Read or listen to lessons, access coach-curated content, and work with your coach to make gradual, meaningful lifestyle changes.
- Access exclusive recipes, guides, videos, and more, to support your learning.
- View your curriculum progress, revisit previous lessons, and preview when your next lessons will be released—so you can plan ahead and stay on track.
CONNECT
- View and manage Appointments with your Calibrate Team of clinicians, nurses and your dedicated coach.
- Prepare for upcoming appointments with provider bios, requirement details, and tips for what to expect.
- Send a message to your Support Team, view Support Message progress, easily reference conversation history, or search FAQs to quickly find answers, all in one place in the Support Center.
MORE ABOUT GLP-1s
Despite what other weight loss programs say, you won’t find long-term results in a magic pill. Even GLP-1s (like tirzepatide and semaglutide) are designed to work on your underlying metabolic pathways to support sustained weight loss—not achieve it outright. Medical experts agree, the combination of GLP-1 medication and lifestyle changes is the most effective approach to lasting weight loss.
PRIVACY 
We understand the importance of safeguarding your medical information and are committed to protecting your privacy. Calibrate complies with federal and state laws, including HIPAA, to maintain the privacy and security of your health information. See our Privacy Policy: https://www.joincalibrate.com/legal/privacy-policy

• Data engineering and data science

• Cybersecurity
• Product management and leadership
The O’Reilly app works best with a membership. Learn more at oreilly.com.

bluejetty:00140347:ios.description:
Evoto: Master Editing, Anytime, Anywhere
Are you spending more time behind a screen than behind the lens? Meet Evoto, the ultimate photo editor built to change how you edit photos. Whether you need to retouch fine details, refine the background, or apply advanced presets, this smart photo editor puts desktop-grade power right in your hands, anytime, anywhere.
PORTRAIT RETOUCHING: PERFECT EVERY DETAIL
Skip the tedious pixel-pushing. Achieve high-end, polished aesthetics with precise sliders and smart automation:
- Natural Skin Retouch: Erase blemishes and smooth skin tones while keeping original pores intact.
- Facial Reshaping: Fine-tune facial features and expressions with pixel-level, natural accuracy.
- Smart Hair Editing: Remove stray hairs, refine hair part lines, and add top volume in one click.
- Body Contouring: Smoothly optimize body lines based on anatomy without warping the background.
SCENIC & COLOR CONTROL: CREATE FLAWLESS SHOTS
Stop letting bad weather, chaotic crowds, or unpredictable lighting ruin a great shoot. Take total control over your environment and color grading in a single tap:
- Instant Style Presets: Apply advanced presets to showcase your style across your entire set immediately.
- Sky & Backdrop Swaps: Replace dull skies and distracting backdrops with clean edge-detection.
- Cinematic Color Grading: Shape your visual brand using filters, curve adjustments, and advanced color match.
- Easy Object Removal: Erase crowds and unwanted objects with seamless, texture-matching fill.
SMART TECH RECOVERY: RESCUE EVERY FRAME
Save almost-perfect shots from technical flaws in just a few taps:
- Clothing De-Wrinkle: Smooth, camera-ready clothing in every shot with flawless precision.
- Eye & Glare Correction: Fix closed eyes, remove harsh glasses glare, and eliminate red-eye instantly.
- Photo Enhancer: Boost clarity and upscale resolution in soft-focus or low-res images.
ARTISTIC VISUAL TOOLS: ELEVATE CREATIVE EXPRESSION
Add artistic flair and next-generation visual effects to elevate your storytelling:
- Storytelling Collage: Combine complementary frames into balanced collage layouts effortlessly.
- Effects Suite: Introduce dynamic energy into your frames with a curated collection of creative panning, zoom, and radial blur effects.
- Creative Light Overlays: Infuse your shots with natural light, golden hour glows, or soft facial fill light.
WORKFLOW EFFICIENCY: OPTIMIZE PRODUCTION SPEED
Streamline your post-production pipeline and shorten turnaround times:
- Tethered Shooting: Connect your camera via wired or wireless connection to view custom retouching styles instantly on screen as you shoot.
- Batch Editing: Automatically sync your exact portrait edits, background fixes, and color grading across multiple images.
- Broad Compatibility: Works with Canon, Sony, Nikon, Fujifilm, Leica, Panasonic, and more.
From raw captures to high-end photography, bridge the gap in just a few taps. Download Evoto and elevate your images.
About Evoto subscriptions:
- We provide monthly subscription and annual subscription for you to choose one best fit your needs.
The Evoto subscription plans include different amounts of credits based on the tier you choose. Unused credits roll over to the next cycle if you renew your subscription. Only charged upon exporting. Subscriptions will auto-renew every year unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. To stop auto renewal, visit Account Settings in App Store after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://res.evoto.ai/ui/www/policy/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://res.evoto.ai/ui/www/policy/privacy.html

bluejetty:00099250:ios.description:
Explore the world smarter with Travel Camera & Compass – your ultimate travel companion!
Whether you’re wandering through ancient cities or hiking remote trails, our app combines powerful tools to help you capture, navigate, and experience the world like never before.
Key Features: 
- Travel Camera: Take stunning photos wherever you go with our optimized travel camera. Every snapshot can be automatically tagged with your location, so you’ll always remember where each memory was made. Plus, choose from a wide range of beautiful styles and filters to make your travel photos stand out – from cinematic tones to vibrant holiday vibes. Perfect for quick snapshots, scenic landscapes, and share-worthy moments..
- Interactive Map with Travel Highlights: Discover new destinations through an immersive world map. We’ve marked iconic landmarks, hidden gems, and trending spots directly on the map. You can view different terrain types – satellite, hybrid, or standard – for a customized navigation experience.
- 3D Globe View: Zoom out and explore the Earth in 3D! A global view helps you visualize your travel path and highlights locations worth visiting.
- Watch Travel Highlight Videos: Get a real feel of places before you go. Watch curated or live video clips from various destinations worldwide, giving you a preview of the adventure that awaits.
- Extract Audio from Videos: Want to save the sound from your favorite travel clips? With just a tap, you can convert any video into an audio file. Great for saving local music, soundscapes, or memorable voice notes.
- Digital Compass: Navigate confidently, even when offline. The built-in compass shows your current direction and bearing – essential for hikers, trekkers, or road trippers.
Why Choose Travel Camera & Compass?
* Combines multiple travel tools in one app
* Helps you discover and plan your next destination
* Enhances your travel experience through rich media
* Intuitive interface designed for travelers of all kinds
* Lightweight and battery-friendly, perfect for long trips
Whether you’re a backpacker, travel vlogger, or casual explorer, Travel Camera & Compass gives you everything you need to document your journey and stay oriented wherever you are.
Travel Camera is your smart travel companion, allowing you to capture, organize, and share beautiful memories from your journeys with ease.
